target_text: Procedimiento para la emisión constante de líquidos volátiles, deacuerdo con el cual se verifica la absorción de los líquidos y/o disolventes volátiles (con o sin solutos acompañantes) contenidos en un depósito, por sólidos absorbentes de los que se desprenden en forma de gas por diferencia de tensión de vapor y arrastre por el aire ambiente sin intervención del propio peso del líquido, caracterizado porque en un depósito o recipiente convencional, conteniendo en estado líquido el producto a difundir, se introduce un elemento tubular con perforaciones estratégicamente distribuidas, que en su interior comporta una masa absorbente, que absorbe el producto en estado líquido para después desprenderlo, y de manera constante, en forma de gas, penetrando en una cámara formada en el extremo superior del cuerpo tubular que comporta la masa absorbente, desde cuya cámara es inducido por el aire ambiente circundante para fluir de manera constante por un paso de salida y dispersión previsto en dicha cámara.Dispositivos para la emisión constante de líquidos volátiles, caracterizados por comprender, en combinación: un depósito general sobre el que se adapta la correspondiente tapa que proporciona un cierre prácticamente estanco, sobre cuya tapa se encuentra ajustado en forma deslizante, un cuerpo tubular con perforaciones convencionales estratégicamente distribuidas, que atraviesa la tapa de cierre y penetra hasta el fondo del depósito y se sumerge en el líquido que contiene; una masa absorbente alojada en el interior de dicho cuerpo tubular quedando sumergida en el líquido que contiene el depósito; un recinto o cámara formada en el sector extremo superior del cuerpo tubular con perforaciones, cuya cámara está desprovista de masa absorbente, y en ella fluye, en forma de gas, el producto contenido en el depósito; una tapa que cierra superiormente dicha cámara, cuya tapa tiene un calado central por el que fluye el producto en forma de gas para su continua dispersión.

source_text: A composition for reducing deposition of a mineral salt from an aqueous supersaturated solution onto a solid surface in contact with the aqueous supersaturated solution which composition comprises a dispersion of either (i) seed crystals of the mineral salt in an aqueous solution of the mineral salt or (ii) seed crystals of a salt isomorphous with the mineral salt in an aqueous solution of the isomorphous salt wherein the dispersed seed crystals are of Mean particle size of less than 2.5 microns.
target_text: Una composición para reducir la deposición de una sal mineral a partir de una solución acuosa supersaturada sobre una superficie sólida en contacto con la solución acuosa supersaturada, cuya composición comprende una dispersión de (i) cristales seminales de la sal mineral en una solución acuosa de la sal mineral o (ii) cristales seminales de una sal isomorfa con la sal mineral en una solución acuosa de la sal isomorfa, en donde los cristales seminales dispersados son de un tamaño medio de partícula menor de 2,5 micrómetros. Un método para reducir la deposición de sales minerales a partir de una solución acuosa supersaturada sobre una superficie sólida en contacto con la solución acuosa supersaturada, caracterizado porque comprende: (a) formar una composición como la reivindicada en cualquiera de las reivindicaciones 1 a 7; (b) distribuir dicha composición en (i) una solución acuosa supersaturada de la sal mineral o en (ii) un líquido precursor acuoso de la solución acuosa supersaturada cuyo líquido precursor acuoso está saturado con respecto a los cristales seminales y, en el caso de (b)(ii), convertir el líquido precursor acuoso a una solución acuosa supersaturada de la sal mineral;y poner en contacto la solución acuosa supersaturada así tratada con la superficie sólida.

source_text: A method and apparatus for controlling the compounding of pharmaceutical parenteral admixtures id disclosed. The apparatus preferably comprises a computer that contains a memory for storing instructions for operating the apparatus and for controlling compounders that prepare a prescription admixture, with the memory including data relating to a plurality of the pharmaceutical components that may be transferred to prepare the prescription admixture, and data concerning the operating characteristics of the compounders that the apparatus is adapted to control. source_text: A microorganism isolated from soil was identified as being a Lactococcus lactis strain (NRRL B-30656) which produced an extracellular transferase enzyme when grown in a medium containing sucrose. This produced a glucose and fructose biopolymer on being purified and placed in a medium with sucrose in suitable temperature and pH conditions.
target_text: Un biopolímero de glucosa y fructosa obtenido a partir de productos del metabolismo de una cepa de Lactococcus lactis depositada bajo el código NRRL B-30656.. (nos parece importante que aparezca la información de la entidad depositaria de la cepa). El biopolímero de la reivindicación 1 en donde los productos del metabolismo, consisten en enzimas con dos tipos de actividad glucosiltransferasa y fructosiltransferasa. El biopolímero de que trata la Reivindicación 1, el cual tiene una composición que mantiene una relación glucosa/fructosa entre 0.2 y 0.7. El biopolímero de acuerdo con una cualquiera de las reivindicaciones 1 a 3, el cual presenta las siguientes propiedades: ? peso molecular 900-11000 Kilodaltons, ? dos puntos de transición vítrea, el primero entre 20 y 30°C y el segundo entre 190 y 220°C,? estabilidad en soluciones acuosas con valores de pH entre 2 y 9,? viscosidad entre 1000 y 3000 centipoises cuando el polímero se encuentra en una concentración de 10 a 20% en una solución acuosa a temperatura de 30°C. ? no higroscópico. ? altamente soluble en agua, capaz de formar dispersiones homogéneas tipo hidrogel hasta una concentración máxima de 50% peso / volumen. Un método de producción de enzimas con dos tipos de actividad glucosiltransferasa y fructosiltransferasa, producidas por la cepa de Lactococcus lactis NRRL 8-30656, que consiste en:a) Activar el microorganismo Lactococcus lactis NRRL 8-30656, empleando un medio que contiene azúcares como fuente de carbono, proteínas como fuente de nitrógeno y sales minerales.b) Fermentar el microorganismo Lactococcus lactis NRRL 8-30656 empleando un medio de cultivo que contiene azúcares como fuente de carbono proternas como fuente de nitrógeno y sales minerales.c) Separar la enzima a partir del medio fermentado empleando centrifugación o ultrafiltración.

source_text: A flexible laminate of films of thermoplastic polymer material comprises fluted ply A and substantially flat ply B, adhered to one another at the crests of A in contact with B. The wavelength of the flutes is preferably no more than 3mm. A has attenuated zones (6) extending parallel to the flute direction, each bonding zone being mainly located within a first attenuated zone (6). Apparatus for forming the laminate comprises aligned grooved fluting rollers and grooved laminating roller. The laminate has useful mechanical characteristics, as a flexible material, e.g. when formed into bags which may be self-supporting. Filler material may be filled into the flutes and/or perforations may be provided in one or both plies after lamination.

source_text: A continuous process is provided for recovering caprolactam from aqueous caprolactam product which includes (i) caprolactam, (ii) impurities, and (iii) water by (a) adding alkali hydroxide to the aqueous caprolactam product, in an amount of not more than 100 mmol alkali hydroxide per kg of caprolactam; (b) reacting at least part of the added alkali hydroxide to form alkali amino caproate, to obtain a caproate-enriched caprolactam product; and (c) distilling the caproate-enriched caprolactam product at reduced pressure.
target_text: 1.- Un proceso continuo para la recuperación de caprolactama a partir de un producto de caprolactama acuoso; dicho producto de caprolactama acuoso contiene (i) caprolactama, (ii) impurezas, y (iii) agua, dicho proceso comprende:- Adición de hidróxido de álcali al producto de caprolactama acuoso, en una cantidad no mayor de 100 mmol de hidróxido de álcali por kg de caprolactama;- Reacción de por lo menos parte del hidróxido de álcali adicionado, para formar caproato amino álcali, para obtener un producto de caprolactama rico en caproato; y- Destilación del producto de caprolactama rico en caproato, a presión reducida.2.- El proceso de acuerdo a la reivindicación 1, en donde el proceso comprende la reacción de la menos 50% mol del hidróxido de álcali adicionado, para formar un caproato amino álcali antes de dicha destilación.

source_text: Disclosed is a method of small particle precipitation, retention and dispersion of a solid or semi-solid material onto or into a carrier material. source_text: The present invention concerns pharmaceutical compositions containing one of the receptors FcgammaR IIa, FcgammaR IIb or FcgammaR III in a recombinantly produced, soluble form and their use to treat diseases or conditions which are caused by overshooting immune reactions and a pathologically increased formation of antibodies, in particular of autoantibodies. source_text: This invention relates to a method for rapid chemical gassing of an emulsion explosive without having toxic nitrogen oxides in the finished emulsion explosive product, when nitrite is used as the gassing component. Urea acts as a gassing accelerator and urea are added in the water lubrication solution or in both the water lubrication solution and in the gassing component. To achieve rapid gassing of an emulsion explosive, the emulsion is prepared at a pH in the range of 0-3, by using an organic acid having at least 3 carbon atoms.
target_text: 1.- Un método para la preparación de una emulsión explosiva sensibilizada en un agujero de aspiración o empaquetado, donde a) una fase combustible y b) una solución oxidante que contiene especies de amonio y sal oxidante y que posee un pH en el rango de 0-3, es emulsificada para formar una emulsión, la cual se somete a gasificación mediante la mezcla con una solución de gasificación que contiene nitrito inorgánico en presencia de úrea como acelerador de gasificación, y donde la emulsión explosiva se suministra un agujero de aspiración o un empaquetado por medio de un tubo o manguera de carga, que permite la gasificación que tiene lugar en el extremo de dicho tubo o manguera.2.- El método de la reivindicación 1 donde el tubo o manguera se lubrica mediante una solución lubricante que contiene úrea para reducir la fricción de la emulsión a través del tubo o manguera.

source_text: The method employing abrasive tools for the combined cutting and trimming of glass or crystal articles is carried out while the article (47) is maintained substantially vertical and while the moil (48) constitutes the bottom part of the glass or crystal mass constituting the article (47) to be machined. source_text: The method consists in electrolytically depositing a thin coating on amobile substrate and then separating the substrate and the layer which formsthe desired sheet. To obtain a good corrosion resistance, a coating composedof an iron-nickel alloy from an electrolytic solution containing 100 - 450g/l of Fe++; 0.05 - 0.5 g/l of Fe+++ and 5 - 50 g/l of Ni++, and showing a pHbetween 2 and 3, is deposited on the substrate. The temperature of theelectrolytic solution is advantageously between 90 degrees C and 120 degreesC, and the current density is preferably between 150 A/dm2 and 200 A/dm2. Itis then possible to deposit electrolytically a layer of chromium of athickness of 0.1 microns to 2 microns on at least one side of said sheet.Finally, it is possible to apply a recrystallisation and/or diffusion heattreatment.
target_text: Le procédé consiste à déposer par voie électrolytique un revêtement de faible épaisseur sur un substrat mobile et à séparer ensuite le substrat et le revêtement qui constitue la feuille désirée. Pour obtenir une bonne résistance à la corrosion, on dépose sur le substrat un revêtement constitué d'un alliage fer-nickel à partir d'une solution d'électrolyse contenant 100 - 450 g/l de Fe++; 0,05 - 0,5 g/l de Fe+++ et 5 - 50 g/l de Ni++, et présentant un pH compris entre 2 et 3. La température de la solution d'électrolyse est avantageusement comprise entre 90 degrés C et 120 degrés C, et la densité de courant est de préférence comprise entre 150 A/dm2 et 200 A/dm2. On peut ensuite déposer par voie électrolytique une couche de chrome d'une épaisseur de 0,1 micromètre à 2 micromètre sur au moins une face de cette feuille. Enfin, on peut appliquer un traitement thermique de recristallisation et/ou diffusion.

source_text: The present invention relates to the melting of steel. The method forproducing steel for standard use comprises the melting of a semi-finishedcarbon product in a steel melting installation, the casting of saidsemi-finished product in a treatment ladle, the addition into said ladle ofdesulphurising substances, a reducing agent and previously heat-treated oxidesubstances containing the alloy elements. The reducing agent is added in theladle in portions such that a first portion is added with said desulphurisingsubstances during the casting in the ladle of not more than 1/3 of the weightof the semi-finished carbon product, and the other portion of reducing agentis added at the same time as the previously heat-treated oxide substances,before the casting of said semi-finished carbon product in the ladle iscomplete. The application of the invention will be most effective in theproduction of steels for standard use with manganese.
target_text: La présente invention concerne la fusion de l'acier. Le procédé de fabrication de l'acier d'usage courant comprend la fusion d'un demi-produit à carbone dans une installation de fusion d'acier, la coulée de ce demi-produit dans une poche de traitement, l'addition dans cette poche de matériaux désulfurants, de réducteur et de matériaux à oxyde préalablement soumis à un traitement thermique et contenant les éléments d'alliage. Le réducteur est additionné dans la poche par portions de sorte qu'une première portion est additionnée avec lesdits matériaux désulfurants pendant la coulée dans la poche de 1/3 au maximum de la masse du demi-produit à carbone, et que l'autre portion de réducteur est additionnée simultanément avec les matériaux à oxyde préalablement soumis au traitement thermique, et cela avant que la coulée dudit demi-produit à carbone dans la poche soit terminée. L'application de l'invention sera la plus efficace dans la fabrication des aciers d'usage courant au manganèse.

source_text: The evolution over time of the temperature on at least one point of theingot mould is determined and compared to the reference evolution over timeof the temperature at the same points. source_text: Method of heat treatment of a steel product leaving the rolling mill in which, during a first stage, the product is subjected to cooling with water to a surface temperature which is equal to or lower than the temperature of the onset of the martensite transformation (Ms point) of the steel, with a rate of cooling which is at least equal to the critical rate for quenching the steel; during a second stage the product is first of all subjected, by virtue of the heat released by the unquenched part of the product, to a reheating of the quenched surface layer to a surface temperature, known as the self-annealing temperature, of between 550 DEG C and 650 DEG C, and then to a secondary cooling to a surface temperature of less than 450 DEG C; the final cooling of the product to a temperature of less than 120 DEG C is then performed, for example with the aid of highly agitated water. During the stage which follows the self-annealing, the product may first of all advantageously be allowed to stay in air up to a temperature of approximately 550 DEG C, and then be cooled at high speed to a temperature substantially below 400 DEG C, and be reheated to a temperature of between 400 DEG C and 420 DEG C before being allowed to cool in air. <IMAGE>

source_text: The primordial role played by trace elements has been well known by thegeneral public for a long time. The presumption of their existence since thestart of this century and the ensuing research led to the recent scientificdemonstration of their existence, cases of deficiency in the human body andthe need to remedy this. It then emerged that it was necessary to preparesimple and suitable products to make up for said deficiencies. Consequently,the purpose of the present invention is to provide trace element-basedpharmaceutical formulations, in the form of orotic acid salts, which make itpossible to reach the cell directly and restore its normal operation. As anexample, we mention a formulation for the treatment of skin, hair and nails.Indeed, if the visible deficiencies in the human body are successfullyeliminated - for example in the hair, nails and skin, etc. - the otherhidden deficiencies will be improved at the same time. Twelve otherformulations are given as examples among the many possible uses of thepresent invention.
target_text: Le rôle primordial joué par les oligo-éléments est bien connu du grand public depuis longtemps. La présomption de leur existence depuis le début de ce siècle, et les recherches qui en découlèrent mirent en évidence, récemment et de manière scientifique, leur existence, les cas de carence dans l'organisme humain et la nécessité d'y pallier. Il est alors apparu nécessaire d'élaborer des produits simples et adéquats, permettant de combler ces déficiences. La présence invention a, par conséquent, pour but de prévoir des compositions pharmaceutiques à base d'oligo-éléments, sous forme de sels d'acide orotique; ces derniers permettant d'atteindre la cellule directement et de rétablir son fonctionnement normal. Nous citons comme exemple une composition pour le traitement de la peau, des cheveux et des ongles. En effet, si l'on parvient à supprimer les déficiences visibles du corps humain - par exemple au niveau des cheveux, des ongles et de la peau, etc - les autres déficiences cachées s'en trouveront par la même occasion améliorées. Douze autres formulations sont données comme exemples parmi les multiples possibilités d'exploitation de la présente invention.

source_text: A reducing gas (GR) is produced from a combustible substance (CS) in a firstreaction vessel (13). source_text: A fine coal, dried and preheated at 200-350 degrees C, is gasified andconverted into carbonisation coke in a gasifier (B), which is maintained at atemperature of 700-1400 degrees C. This produces a reducing gas (CO + H2)which is used to reduce, pre-reduce and dry and preheat an ore, in severalsteps (E, D, C). The hot partially oxidised reducing gas leaving thesedifferent steps (E, D, C) is recycled, at least partly, in a gasifier (B),where it provides the oxidant elements required to produce reducing gas fromcarbonisation coke. The temperature of the gasifier (B) can be maintained byburning part of the recycled reducing gas and/or part of the carbonisationcoke. The recycled reducing gas can be reheated by means of heating fumesfrom the gasifier (B). This gives a hot iron sponge, that can be used toproduce quality cast iron or steel.
target_text: Un charbon fin, séché et préchauffé à 200-350 degrés C, est gazéifié et transformé en semi-coke dans un gazéificateur (B), qui est maintenu à une température de 700-1400 degrés C. On produit ainsi un gaz réducteur (CO + H2) qui sert à réduire, à préréduire et à sécher et préchauffer un minerai, en plusieurs étapes (E,D,C). Le gaz réducteur partiellement oxydé et chaud quittant ces différentes étapes (E,D,C) est recyclé, au moins en partie, dans le gazéificateur (B), où il apporte les éléments oxydants nécessaires pour produire du gaz réducteur à partir du semi-coke. La température du gazéificateur (B) peut être maintenue en brûlant une partie du gaz réducteur recyclé et/ou une partie du semi-coke. Le gaz réducteur recyclé peut être réchauffé au moyen des fumées du chauffage du gazéificateur (B). On obtient ainsi une éponge de fer chaude utilisable pour produire de la fonte ou de l'acier de qualité.

source_text: A fine coal, dried and preheated, is subjected to a distillation operationcombined with the gasification of the carbonisation coke resulting from thedistillation. In this way, a reducing gas is obtained, essentially composedof CO and H2 which is used, in several steps, to dry and preheat an ore,pre-reduce and reduce it. Thisgives an iron sponge that can be used to produce cast iron or quality steel.The improvement consists in that, before recycling the majority of thegaseous mixture from at least one of the final ore reduction, pre-reductionand drying and preheating steps in the distillation installation, the volumeof the gaseous mixture is reduced by subjecting it to a physical, chemical orphysicochemical treatment, preferably by reducing the CO2 content, possiblyfor example by partial decarbonation.
target_text: Un charbon fin, séché et préchauffé, est soumis à une opération de distillation combinée à la gazéification du semi-coke résultant de la distillation. On produit ainsi un gaz réducteur composé essentiellement de CO et H2 qui sert, en plusieurs étapes, à sécher et préchauffer un minerai, à le préréduire et à le réduire. Le mélange gazeux quittant ces différentes étapes est recyclé, au moins en partie, dans l'étape de distillation et de gazéification, le CO2 et le H2O servant à y oxyder partiellement le semi-coke. On obtient ainsi une éponge de fer utilisable pour produire de la fonte ou de l'acier de qualité. Le perfectionnement consiste en ce que, avant de recycler dans l'installation de distillation et de gazéification la majeure partie du mélange gazeux provenant d'au moins une des étapes de réduction finale, de préréduction et de séchage et préchauffage du minerai, on réduit le volume du mélange gazeux en lui faisant subir un traitement physique, chimique ou physico-chimique, de préférence en diminuant la teneur en CO2, par exemple par décarbonatation éventuellement partielle.

source_text: Energy system comprising several gas turbines characterised by a use of thermal energy produced by the combustion of exhaust gases and by the implementation of partial oxidation carried out by means of air introduced in a sub-stoechiometric quantity and water vapour in a catalytic reaction vessel (7), so as to form a first combustion step. Said step is then completed downstream in the turbine (3) by an additional combustion in a downstream power turbine (4). The use of said catalytic partial oxidation is characterised in that it is accompanied by the supply of hydrogen according to a specified quantity at the catalytic oxidation reaction vessel inlet. This hydrogen is produced either by recycling part of the effluent of said reaction vessel (7) or the power turbine (4), or a "reforming" reaction vessel of a part of the combustible gas with a large excess of water vapour, or the industrial site itself. In addition, several different catalytic substances are provided.
target_text: Système énergétique comportant plusieurs turbines à gaz remarquable par une valorisation d'énergie thermique produite par la combustion des gaz d'échappement et par la réalisation de l'oxydation partielle effectuée au moyen d'air introduit en quantité sous-stoechiométrique et de vapeur d'eau dans un réacteur catalytique (7), de façon à former une première étape de combustion. Celle-ci est ensuite complétée en aval dans la turbine (3) par une combustion additionnelle dans une turbine de puissance d'aval (4). La mise en oeuvre de l'oxydation partielle catalytique précitée est remarquable en ce qu'elle est accompagnée de l'amenée d'hydrogène selon une quantité déterminée à l'entrée du réacteur d'oxydation catalytique. Cet hydrogène provient soit d'un recyclage d'une partie de l'effluent de ce réacteur (7) ou de la turbine de puissance (4), soit d'un réacteur de"reforming" d'une partie du gaz combustible avec de la vapeur d'eau en large excès, soit du site industriel propre. En outre, plusieurs masses catalytiques différentes sont prévues.

source_text: Sulphur elimination method from iron ore agglomeration fumes, wherein at least part of said fumes are recycled, particularly the fraction with the highest sulphur oxide content. The fumes are heated by means of at least one burner (9) and at least one desulphurising agent (10) capable of forming, at a high temperature, a stable solid compound with the sulphur present in the fumes is injected into said fumes. The fumes treated in this way (11) are then recycled in a hood (12), referred to as the recycling hood, which covers at least part of the agglomeration belt (1), and the stable solid sulphur compound is collected in the agglomerated substance (6) produced on the agglomeration belt. The desulphurising agent preferentially comprises a calcium compound, such as lime or calcine. It may be injected directly into the flame of said burner (9) and/or in the immediate vicinity of said flame.<IMAGE>
target_text: Procédé d'élimination du soufre des fumées d'agglomération des minerais de fer, dans lequel on recycle au moins une partie de ces fumées, en particulier la fraction la plus chargée en oxydes de soufre. On chauffe les fumées au moyen d'au moins un brûleur (9) et on injecte dans ces fumées au moins un agent désulfurant (10) capable de former, à haute température, un composé solide stable avec le soufre présent dans les fumées. On recycle ensuite les fumées ainsi traitées (11) dans une hotte (12), dite hotte de recyclage, qui couvre au moins une partie de la bande d'agglomération (1), et on recueille le composé solide stable de soufre dans la matière agglomérée (6) produite sur la bande d'agglomération. L'agent désulfurant comprend de préférence un composé du calcium, tel que la chaux ou la castine. Il peut être injecté directement dans la flamme dudit brûleur (9) et/ou à proximité immédiate de celle-ci.

source_text: Method of manufacturing a hot-rolled strip of high-tensile steel, that has a carbon and manganese content of between 0.04 percent and 0.2 percent and 0.5 percent and 2 percent by weight respectively. The steel additionally contains niobium with a content of between 0.01 percent and 0.1 percent by weight, the rest being iron and the usual impurities. The finishing hot-rolling of this steel is carried out between an initial temperature of less than 950 degrees centigrade and a final temperature above the austenite to ferrite (Ar3) transition temperature, with a thickness reduction rate of at least 85 percent. In less than 5 seconds after the hot rolling, the steel is cooled at a cooling rate of more than 20 degrees centigrade/second from the aforementioned final temperature down to a temperature of less than 200 degrees centigrade and the hot-rolled steel strip is spooled at this temperature of less than 200 degrees centigrade.<IMAGE>
target_text: Procédé pour fabriquer une bande laminée à chaud en acier à haute résistance, dont les teneurs en carbone et en manganèse sont comprises, en poids, entre 0,04 % et 0,2 % et entre 0,5 % et 2 % respectivement. L'acier contient en outre du niobium en une teneur comprise entre 0,01 % et 0,1 % en poids, le reste étant du fer et des impuretés habituelles. On effectue le laminage à chaud de finition de cet acier entre une température initiale inférieure à 950 degré C et une température finale supérieure à la température de transformation de l'austénité en ferrite (Ar3), avec un taux de réduction d'épaisseur d'au moins 85 %. Dans un délai inférieur à 5 s après le laminage à chaud, on refroidit l'acier avec une vitesse de refroidissement supérieure à 20 degré C/s à partir de la température finale précitée jusqu'à une température inférieure à 200 degré C et on bobine la bande d'acier laminée à chaud à cette température inférieure à 200 degré C.

source_text: The invention relates to multiple glazing and to a process of manufacturing same. source_text: Method of eliminating dioxin from iron ore agglomeration fumes, wherein at least a portion of said agglomeration fumes are recycled, particularly the portion of the fumes with the highest dioxin content. The fumes are heated, for example in a reaction vessel (7) by means of at least one burner (9), to a temperature of at least 850 degrees C for a time of at least 2 seconds, and the fumes treated in this way are cooled suddenly to a temperature below 200 degrees C. The fumes to be treated (10) are injected into a recycling hood (11) covering the agglomeration belt at least partially, and they are cooled by passing them through a wet zone located under the flame front in the layer of material to be agglomerated. The wet zone preferentially consists of the part of the substance to be agglomerated, which has not yet been reached by the flame front.<IMAGE>
target_text: Procédé d'élimination des dioxines des fumées d'agglomération des minerais de fer, dans lequel on recyle au moins une partie de ces fumées d'agglomération, en particulier la partie des fumées la plus chargée en dioxines. On chauffe les fumées, par exemple dans un réacteur (7) au moyen d'au moins un brûleur (9), jusqu'à une température d'au moins 850 degré C pendant une durée d'au moins 2 secondes, et on refroidit brusquement les fumées ainsi traitées jusqu'à une température inférieure à 200 degré C. La zone humide est de préférence constituée par la partie de la matière à agglomérer qui n'a pas encore été atteinte par le front de flamme.

source_text: Method of coating a steel strip by hot-dip galvanising, wherein the coated strip is subjected to galvannealing after it leaves the galvanising bath. Intense superficial heat is applied to the coated strip between its emergence from the galvanising bath and the start of the galvannealing. This heating causes a rise in the strip surface temperature between 80 degrees centigrade and 300 degrees centigrade relative to the temperature of the strip when it leaves the galvanising bath. Heating is carried out for a period of less than 0.5 seconds and causes the temperature to rise to a depth of less than 0.2 mm. It allows the inhibiting layer to being destabilised and the galvannealing treatment to be applied to any tone of steel, from a conventional galvanising bath. Applicable to the coating on one or two surfaces of the strip<IMAGE>
target_text: Procédé de revêtement d'une bande d'acier par galvanisation au trempé, dans lequel on soumet la bande revêtue à un recuit d'alliation après sa sortie du bain de galvanisation. On applique à la bande revêtue un chauffage superficiel intense entre la sortie du bain de galvanisation et le début du recuit d'alliation. Ce chauffage provoque une élévation de la température de la surface de la bande comprise entre 80 degré C et 300 degré C par rapport à la température de la bande à la sortie du bain de galvanisation. source_text: The invention concerns a method for measuring gas transfer time inside an enclosed space, such as a blast furnace, which consists in injecting a gas, called tracer gas, in a point A or A' of the enclosed space, for example a nozzle, and in tapping in a point B of the same enclosed space the gas present therein, the point A or A' being different from point B; in detecting the presence of the tracer gas in the gas tapped in B, and deducing therefrom the time required by the tracer gas to travel from point A or A' to point B on the basis of the data supplied by the detection system. The method also consists in carrying out at least one in-situ measurement of the response time, that is a calibration, of the tapping system in B. The calibration consists in injecting at the tapping point, concerning the equipment to be calibrated, an amount of a predetermined gas and in measuring the time separating said injection and the detection of said gas in the tapping and detecting equipment. Various methods are described two of which use tapping pipes with coaxial tubes and one with a single tube pipe. In case a rare gas, such as helium, is used as tracer gas, the blow-down gas can be nitrogen and the calibrating gas can be a helium-nitrogen mixture.

source_text: Process of de-scaling a steel strip by passing it through a bath of molten salt, such as sodium oxides or borates, integrated into a continuous line process. The steel strip may be subjected to a cathodic polarisation and the de-scaling process applies to a steel strip, which emerges from a heat treatment such as hot-rolling or a continuous heat treatment. source_text: The invention relates to the use of a peptide composed of a betainecombined with an amino acid with a peptide bond, in order to eliminate orprevent physiopathological vascular disorders resulting from ischemia andthrombosis. According to the invention, the amino acids that can be combinedwith betaine with a peptide bond are: aspartate, glutamate, lysine,arginine, histidine, serine, theronine, aspargine, glutamine, alanine,valine, leucine, isoleucine, proline, methionine, phenylalanine, glycine,cyteine, tyrosine and tryptophan. The invention relates to the curative andpreventive activity of said peptide in the pathogenesis of thromboembolicand haemostatic diseases of arterial or venous origin. Indeed, it hasemerged that the administration of a peptide, composed of a betaine combinedwith an amino acid by a peptide bond, prevents venous or arterial thrombusformation and exerts a strong thrombolytic and fibrinolytic action bydissolving the clot or thrombus already formed.

Selon l'invention les acides aminés pouvant être associés à la bétaine par une liaison peptidique sont: l'aspartate, glutamate, lysine, arginine, histidine, sérine, theronie, aspargine, glutamine, alanine, valine, leucine, isoleucine, proline, méthionine, phénylalanine, glycine, cytéine, tyrosine et tryptophane. source_text: The invention concerns a method for making a continuous steel strip, which consists in: dipping the steel strip, at a temperature ranging between 700 DEG C and 850 DEG C, in an aqueous bath maintained at a temperature above room temperature; adding to the aqueous bath at least a surfactant capable of lowering the surface tension of said aqueous bath by at least 20 dynes/cm; adding said surfactant in a proportion ranging between 0.5 g/l and 50 g/l and thereby lowering the aqueous bath surface tension to a value less than 30 dynes/cm. The temperature of the bath can be substantially its boiling point. Preferably, surfactants capable of resisting to temperatures above 110 DEG C, to pressure levels of at least 2 bar, and optionally to organic acids added to the bath are used, when making a non-oxidised strip.
target_text: Dans un procédé de fabrication d'une bande d'acier en continu, dans lequel on plonge la bande d'acier, à une température comprise entre 700 et 850 degré C, dans un bain aqueux maintenu à une température supérieure à la température ambiante, on ajoute au bain acqueux au moins une substance tensio-active capable d'abaisser la tension superficielle de ce bain aqueux d'au moins 20 dynes/cm. On ajoute cette substance tensio-active en une proportion comprise entre 0,5g/l et 50g/l, et on abaisse ainsi la tension superficielle du bain aqueux à une valeur inférieure à 30 dynes/cm. La température du bain peut être sensiblement sa température d'ébullition, ou une température de 50 à 90 degré C. On utilise de préférence des substances tensio-actives capables de résister à des températures supérieurs à 110 degré C, à des pressions d'au moins 2 bar, et éventuellement à des acides organiques ajoutés au bain, lorsque l'on désire fabriquer une bande non oxydée.

source_text: The invention relates to the metallurgy of nonferrous metals, and in particular, the treatment of tungsten waste, and may be applied by companies treating nonferrous metals. source_text: Continuous heat treatment of steel sheet involves a divided two stage cooling operation using water vapor and water to furnish two specific and controlled iron oxide layers. <??>The continuous heat treatment of a steel sheet includes subjecting it to a divided cooling operation with the following successive stages: <??>(a) at the start of cooling, whilst the sheet is at high temperatures of between 400 and 900 degrees C, direct contact of the sheet is provoked with water vapor to create a first layer of iron oxides (FexOy) of a specific and controlled composition such that the ratio of the iron (Fe) and oxygen (O) contents of the medium composition of the iron oxide is between 3 and 3.5, the thickness of the oxide layer being between 10 and 100 nm, and preferably between 20 and 50 nm; <??>(b) the sheet is then exposed directly to water in the liquid state, leading to the formation of a second layer of iron oxides, which may be of the type Fe3O4 and Fe2O3. <??>An Independent claim is also included for a device for putting this method of heat treatment into service.
target_text: La présente invention se rapporte à un procédé de traitement thermique en continu d'une tôle d'acier, de préférence de recuit continu, dans lequel on soumet ladite tôle à au moins une étape de refroidissement scindée en au moins les deux sous-étapes successives suivantes: au début du refroidissement, lorsque la tôle est encore à haute température, de préférence entre 400 et 900)C, on provoque un contact direct de ladite tôle avec de la vapeur d'eau pour créer sur la tôle une première couche d'oxyde(s) de fer FexOy de composition spécifiée et contrôle telle que le rapport entre les teneurs massiques en éléments [Fe] et [O] de la composition moyenne d'oxyde FexOy soit compris entre 3 et 3,5 l'épaisseur de la dite couche étant comprise entre 10 et 100 nm, et de préférence entre 20 et 50 nm; on expose ensuite la tôle directement à de l'eau à l'état liquide, ce qui conduit à la formation d'une deuxième couche d'oxyde(s) de fer, pouvant comprendre des oxydes de type Fe3O4 et Fe2O3.

source_text: Disclosed is a method for patenting at least one steel wire, according to which the temperature is increased at least to a level at which the steel austenitizes, followed by quenching in a liquid medium by directing the wire through at least one curtain of cooling liquid so as to obtain a cooling temperature that lies below the austenitizing temperature, the liquid flowing in a turbulent manner substantially perpendicular to the wire, followed by an isothermal stage during which the wire is maintained at a constant temperature allowing pearlitic transformation. source_text: Various aspects of a process for producing energy and fuel from municipal refuse are claimed, e.g. a screw press comprising a porous body in a sealed tube from which a vacuum pump can extract air from the refuse during compaction. The following aspects of a process for producing energy and fuel from municipal refuse are claimed: (1) a screw press comprising a porous body in a sealed tube from which a vacuum pump can extract air from the refuse during compaction; (2) use of gas capable of producing atomic carbon, oxygen and hydrogen by molecular dissociation as a plasma-generating gas; (3) use of slag from electric foundry furnaces to fix solid carbon ejected by the plasma arc; (4) injection by screw press of the necessary amount of slag plus 12 g of coke or graphite per mole of carbon dioxide used as plasma-generating gas; (5) use of gas or methanol burners to gasify or burn solid carbon; (6) the number of moles of carbon dioxide dissociated by the plasma is a function of the intended aim; (7) the plasma is maintained at a temperature sufficient to fuse all inorganic materials; (8) the gasification temperature is controlled by injecting carbon monoxide and water; (9) substances necessary for desired chemical transformations are added to the refuse during compaction; (10) the plasma is optionally rotated by supplying 3x torches (x is greated than 1) with x-phase alternating current; (11) the spouts of the reactor are heated by induction; (12) the heat exchanger is protected from hydrogen chloride by a quartz plasma; (13) hydrogen is separated by molecular membrane techniques after cooling the gas by scrubbing; (14) the heating value lost by hydrogen removal is restored by adding methane produced from refuse; (15) the gas turbine temperature is controlled by injecting carbon dioxide into the synthesis gas and spraying water into the combustion chamber; (16) natural gas is added to the turbine exhaust gas to produce methanol; (17) the methanol can be used in fuel cells equipped with a reformer; (18) deuterium and hydrogen are produced by electrolysis of water using the excess electricity production; (19) the hydrogen is used as a fuel for zero emission automobiles.
target_text: Le procédé consiste en la pyrolyse des déchets ménagers par la chaleur de la dissociation moléculaire d'un gaz ou d'un mélange de gaz à une température supérieure à 3000°C obtenue grâce à l'énergie électrique sous forme de plasma, de chauffage inductif ou par pertes dans le dielectrique que constitue le gaz. Une injection de graphite dans le plasma, modifiera l'équilibre atomique et provoquere dès 2000°C, une réaction exothermique considérable. Les températures très élevées seront maintenues dans des limites acceptables par les installations Turbine-Vapeur et Turbine-Gaz-Vapeur par des injections de CO2 et H2 à des endroits bien précis. A un endroit précis du cycle, on pourra extraire H2du gaz de synthèse. Toutes les injections de CO2 et H2O seront telles que les gaz d'échappement de la Turbine-Gaz seront composés de CO2 et H2O dans le rapport: CO2=11/9 H2Oà la température de l'ordre de 770K°. On ajoutera, à un gaz d'échappement, la quantité adéquate de gaz naturel afin d'obtenir à 500K°,

source_text: The continuous annealing of steel strip prior to dip galvanising consists of subjecting the strip to a preheating by direct flame or by radiation to form on its surface a controlled film of oxide containing 0.1 to 1 g/m2> of oxygen, the oxygen content being controlled by modifying the air/gas ratio of the mixture fed to the direct flame heating system or by controlled air injection in the radiation heating zone. The strip is then subjected to radiation heating under an atmosphere made up of an inert gas or a mixture of inert gas in relation to the steel, of which the dew point is less than or equal to -10[deg]C. Finally, the strip is subjected to an operation of complete reduction of the iron oxide present in the oxide film, formed in the preheating zone and matured in the annealing zone, by means of a reducing atmosphere made up of a mixture with a low dew point, less than -20[deg]C, of nitrogen and hydrogen with between 5 and 5 % of hydrogen. An independent claim is also included for a furnace for the continuous annealing of steel strip by this method.
target_text: Procédé de recuit en continu d'une bande d'acier en vue de sa galvanisation au trempé, dans lequel la bande subit un préchauffage soit par flamme directe, soit par radiation, en vue de former sur sa surface un film contrôlé d'oxyde contenant de 0,1 à 1g/m2 d'oxygène, le contenu en oxygène de la couche d'oxyde étant controlé soit par modification du rapport air/gaz du mélange alimentant des moyens de chauffage par flamme directe, soit par injection d'air contrôlée dans la zone en question lors du chauffage par des moyens radiants. Ladite bande subit ensuite un chauffage par radiation sous une atmosphère composée d'un gaz inerte ou d'un mélange de gaz inerte vis-à-vis de l'acier dont le point de rosée est inférieur ou égal à -10°C. Finalement, ladite bande subit une opération de réduction complète de l'oxyde de fer-présent dans la couche d'oxyde formée dans la zone de préchauffe et maturée dans la zone de recuit-au moyen d'une atmosphère réductrice constituée d'un mélange à bas point de rosée (inférieur à -20°C) d'azote et d'hydrogéne entre 5% et 75% en fraction d'hydrogéne.

source_text: The procedure, designed to control the distribution of granular materials - iron ore and fuel - on an agglomeration belt (2) consists of delivering the granular materials (1) via a hopper (3) and distribution roller (4) onto an inclined support (P1) where is it subject to a fluid (6) such as air under pressure in an operation called blowing. The blowing parameters are regulated to separate the granules by weight so that the heavier ones are closest to the support, and lighter ones are separated by successive inclined supports (P2, P3, P4) so they reach the belt in one layer (5) with the heaviest granules at the bottom and the lightest on top. The separation of the granules in the flow is assisted by dividers (13, 14, 15) at the upper ends of the inclined supports, which are set at angles (AP1, AP2, AP3, AP4) of between 20 and 85 degrees to the horizontal.

Après soufflages, on divise la couche en deux couches dites inférieure et supérieure. On dépose la couche inférieure, qui contient une plus grande proportion de gros granules que la couche supérieur, sur la bande. source_text: The surface of a roller forming part of a sheet metal mill is irradiated by an interrupted laser beam which, as the roller is turned, develops a series of microcraters. The positioning of the craters is determined by the rate of turning of the roller, the rate of interruption of the laser beam, and the traverse rate of the laser as it moves from one end of the roller to the other. During the formation of each microcrater, a jet of reducing gas is directed obliquely at the roller surface to produce an associated ridge which partly surrounds the crater. The dimensions of the ridge are determined by the jet force and direction applied. In a subsequent phase, the ridge formed is re-melted by a subsidiary beam to ensure complete adhesion with the roller surface. The resulting pattern is transferred to any sheets rolled, improving their ductility for stamping and their receptivity to superimposed coats.
target_text: Procédé pour le traitement superficiel d'un cylindre de laminoir (1) dans lequel, au moyen d'un faisceau laser intermittent (3), on forme dans la surface du cylindre une multitude de microcratères comportant chacun un bourrelet partiel (6). Après le marquage de la surface, on réchauffe le bourrelet (6) ainsi que la portion de la surface du cylindre sur laquelle il est déposé, jusqu'à une température suffisante pour provoquer un début de fusion et le soudage du bourrelet à cette portion de la surface du cylindre. On opère de préférence ce réchauffage au moyen d'un second faisceau laser (9), qui peut etre obtenu en déviant au moins une partie du faisceau laser intermittent (3).

source_text: A process for production of tetrahydrofuran and gamma butyrolactone by hydrogenation of maleic anhydride recovered from a process of conversion of a n-butane. The process consists essentially of the following steps: A) converting n-butane to maleic anhydride by catalytic vapor phase oxidation; B) recovering maleic anhydride from the effluent gases of butane oxidation by selective absorption in gamma butyrolactone, forming a maleic anhydride-gamma butyrolactone mixture; C) removing water from the maleic anhydride-gamma butyrolactone mixture in a stripper under the action of a gas and/or under vacuum conditions, producing a maleic anhydride-gamma butyrolactone mixture with minimum water and maleic acid content; D) recovering gamma butyrolactone contained in the exhaust gases leaving the maleic anhydride absorber, by absorption in water; E) dehydrating the recovered gamma butyrolactone and recycling it to the maleic anhydride absorber; F) hydrogenating the dewatered maleic anhydride-gamma butyrolactone mixture, over suitable catalyst (s), under conditions favouring the formation of tetrahydrofuran and gamma butyrolactone; G) separating by distillation tetrahydrofuran, gamma butyrolactone and the by-products from the resulting hydrogenation mixture; H) recycling a gamma butyrolactone rich stream to the selective absorption of maleic anhydride.
target_text: Le procédé comprend les étapes ci-dessous: a) conversion de n-butane en anhydride maléique; b) absorption sélective de l'anhydride maléique de l'effluent de a) par dans un courant riche en gamma-butyrolactone; c) élimination de l'eau du mélange produit sous b) pour produire un mélange à teneur minimale en eau et en acide maléique; d) récupération du gamma-butyrolactone de l'effluent de l'absorbeur d'anhydride maléique, par absorption dans l'eau; e) déhydratation du gamma-butyrolactone récupéré et recyclage vers l'absorbeur d'anhydride maléique; f) hydrogénation du mélange d'anhydride maléique et de gamma-butyrolactone débarrassé de son eau; g) séparation du tétrahydrofurane, du gamma-butyrolactone et des sous-produits du mélange d'hydrogénation obtenu; h) recyclage d'un courant riche en gamma-butyrolactone vers l'absorption sélective d'anhydride maléique.

source_text: A continuous process for converting by transesterification the diester of polytetramethylene ether (PTMEA) to the corresponding polytetramethylene ether glycol (PTMEG). The process is characterized by the fact that the feed, consisting of PTMEA along with an alkanol (preferably methanol) and with an alkali metal oxide, hydroxide or alkoxide catalyst (preferably sodium methaoxide) is made to react in two multistaged reactions in series. In the first reactant, including stages of retention in association with distillation trays of high efficiency, the bulk of conversion is achieved by stripping the alkanol ester formed in the transesterification with vapors of hot alkanol having a reduced content of alkanol ester. The transesterification is completed in the second reaction by stripping the effluent from the first reactor with vapors of hot alkanol almost free of alkanol ester. The PTMEG product is finally purified by neutralizing the alkaline catalyst with a mixture of phosphoric acid and sodium phosphate monobasic.
target_text: Procédé pour convertir en continu le diester de l'éther de polytétraméthylène (PTMEA) en l'éther de glycol de polytétraméthylène correspondant (PTMEG) en recourant à deux réacteurs en série. Dans le premier réacteur (R-), on atteint une conversion non inférieure à 99%, qui est améliorée dans le deuxième réacteur (R-2), dans lequel l'effluent du premier (ligne 11) subit une séparation par des vapeurs chaudes de méthanol (ligne 12). Dans le deuxième réacteur (R-2), la conversion est amenée à des valeurs dépassant 99,99%, ce qui garantit la qualité du produit de PTMEG.

source_text: A device for the continuous measurement of the magnetic properties of an iron ore sinter cake (4) comprises an induction coil (1), with an electric current of a given frequency passing through it, and wound around a ferromagnetic core (2), preferably in the form of a U with its ends turned towards the sinter cake. The core forms, with the sinter cake and the two end gaps (8, 8'), a closed magnetic circuit (7) of which the reluctance depends on the reluctance of the end gaps, the sinter cake and the core. The reluctance approximates to the following relationship: RTOTAL = R8 + Rgateau + R8' + Rfer, where R8 and R8' are the reluctance of the end gaps, Rgateau is the reluctance of the sinter cake and Rfer is the reluctance of the ferromagnetic core. An Independent claim is also included for a method for the on-line control of the quality of ignition of an iron ore sinter cake and the degree of sintering of the surface layer of the sinter cake.

source_text: The mini vacuum cleaner comprises a tubular body with a pipe joining its side at an angle, for the introduction of compressed air. The air flows through the body, past an internal tube, creating a depression which draws air in through a nozzle. This is used to draw dust particles off new paint. The mini vacuum cleaner for removal of dust from car bodywork paint comprises a tubular body with a telescopic end point. A pipe joins the side of the tubular body at an angle, and allows introduction of compressed air. The air enters the body of the tube near the lower end and flows up the tubular body past the open end of an internal tube which is linked to the nozzle of the vacuum cleaner, and out through a filter at the upper end of the body. The pressurized air introduced by the orifice (A) passes over the internal tube (B) and creates a depression (C) at the end of this tube. This gives rise to an inflow of air through the nozzle (D). The position of the nozzle is guided by a telescopic end point (E).

source_text: Method for in vitro culture, propagation and replication, with high yield and inside host cells, of viruses (A) that are difficult to multiply in vitro in which the host cells are grown under hypoxic conditions, is new. Method for in vitro culture, propagation and replication, with high yield and inside host cells, of viruses (A) that are difficult to multiply in vitro, such as those of the hepadna-, flavi- or circa-viridae families, parvo virus, including erythro virus, their autonomes, variants and recombinants. The new feature is that the cells are grown under hypoxic conditions, preferably in presence of cobalt or at acid pH.

source_text: Heat treatment of a cold-rolled steel strip involves annealing at a temperature located in the austenitic phase of the steel, cooling to a temperature located in the inter-critical region between the eutectoid and austenitic temperatures, stabilization at the final temperature of cooling, and tempering to ambient temperature. Heat treatment of a cold-rolled steel strip involves heating to an annealing temperature above the A3 temperature, stabilization at the annealing temperature, and tempering at a temperature below the critical temperature of martensitic transformation (Ms). The annealing temperature is above that of austenitic transformation (A3). Between the stabilization and tempering stages, the steel strip is cooled to an intermediate temperature between the A1 and A3 transformation points, and is stabilized at the intermediate temperature. Independent claims are given for: (a) a process for the production of a formable steel strip; and (b) a formable steel strip obtained by the invented processes.
target_text: La présente invention concerne un procédé pour le traitement thermique d'une bande d'acier laminée à froid, comprenant un chauffage jusqu'à une température de recuit supérieure à la température de recuit suspérieure à la température A3 et une stabilisation à celle-ci, un refroidissement jusqu'à une température située dans le domaine intercritique entre A1 et A3, une stabilisation à celle-ci et une trempe martensitique. L'invention concerne également un procédé de fabrication d'une bande d'acier adapté au fromage, en particulier l'emboutissage profond, utilisant ledit procédé de traitement thermique et une bande d'acier adapté au formage, obtenue au moyen dudit procédé.

source_text: Augmentation of the quantity of carbon (4) consumed at the tuyeres (2) of a shaft furnace (1), preferably a blast furnace in which a part of the carbon gasification reactions, that is to say the cracking and partial oxidation reactions of certain volatile components, as well as a partial gasification of the formed semi-coke, is effected outside the furnace in an adequately pressurized reactor (11). source_text: The procedure consists of subjecting the material containing hexavalent chrome to a lixiviation process to form a liquid phase and a solid phase. The lixiviation is carried out in an acid medium in the presence of a reducing agent in order to convert the hexavalent chrome into trivalent chrome in solution and raising the pH during lixiviation to give a preferable level close to 4. The reducing agent contains thiosulphate ions or zinc; the former can be manufactured from the residue of used photographic fixing baths, while the latter is employed in the form of a powder with a mean grain size of 50 - 500, and preferably 50 - 150 microns, fragments measuring 4 - 6 mm, or plates. After lixiviation the liquid and solid phases are separated by physical means such as filtration, sieving or cycloning. Calcium chloride is added to the residual solution to precipitate sulphate in the form of gypsum.
target_text: L'invention est relative à un procédé pour le traitement d'une solution contenant du chrome hexavalent dans lequel un réducteur consistant en une poudre métallique à base de zinc et/ou d'aluminium ou en des thiosulfates est ajouté à cette solution et le pH de cette dernière est maintenu à une valeur entre 1 et 6,5 afin de soumettre le chrome hexavalent à une réduction chimique pour obtenir du chrome trivalent. L'invention concerne également.

source_text: The process uses a cold plasma reactor with, depending on the gases to be extracted from the air, a filter for fatty molecules and/or a filter for extracting moist water vapor before its cold plasma section created by an intense electrical field produced by one or more sets of concentric or adjacent electrodes. The outer electrode in each set has a particular shape, such as spiral or half square, solid or perforated, assembled in a ring with a non-uniform discharge intervals so that an intense field cannot exist at all points at the same time and the cold plasma cannot degenerate into an electric arc. The outer electrode can surround one or more inner electrodes with smooth surfaces or comb-shaped projections to give an intense electrical field for a relatively low tension.

(Tgel) at which chemical reactions between the components of the ascending gas ceases, the reducing gas yield (I) at the xxxxxxx level, the hourly heat loss (Pth) from the furnace, and the fraction (R) of the heat loss from the part of the furnace below the level defined by Tzr; and (c) determining the values of the control parameters, i.e. the oxidising gas supply rate (Da), the fuel supply rate (Dc) and the thermal input (p, i.e. the enthalpy of the oxidising gas and fuel introduced at the tuyeres per unit time), theoretically required to achieve the target values of (a). - (d) The values of the parameters are applied to the furnace, followed by (e) measuring the compsn. and temp. of the top gas; and (f) by using the values from (e), the values of Pth, R and Tzr and the values applied in (d), determining the average actual vaues of (I) and Tgel and the corresp. values of Pr, Si, Tf and C. (g) The values of Pr, Si, Tf and C obtd. in (f) are compared with the target values of (a) and any differences are measured. If the differences are zero, the control parameter values applied in (d), are not modified. If, for more than one interval, the differences are not zero and if the value of Tgel determined in (f) does not differ by more than 20 deg.C from the value in (b), steps (c) to (f) are repeated using each time the values of (I) and Tgel determined in step (f) of the preceding sequence as well as values of Pr, Si, Tf and C also determined in (f), until the average values of Pr, Si, Tf and C at at least one interval correspond to the target values.
target_text: Procédé de conduite d'un haut fourneau, consistant à fixer des valeurs de consigne des paramètres caractéristiques de la fonte produite (résultats Pr, Si, Tf, C) à déterminer, par un algorithme approprié, les valeurs de paramètres de réglage conduisant théoriquement à ces valeurs de consigne et à adapter les valeurs de ces paramètres de réglage en fonction de paramètres internes du fourneau, de façon à atteindre les valeurs de consigne fixées des résultats. Cette adaptation basée sur la détermination, à intervalles prédéterminés entre deux coulées successives, des valeurs réelles des paramètres internes et des résultats.

source_text: The process is of the type in which a mass of small pieces of the prod. are cooked in water. All the free water is drained off leaving spaces in the cooked mass which remains moist. The mass of prod. is continually agitated, pref. inside a closed, horizontal, rotary drum. The interior of the drum is pref. equipped to produce a churning action on the mass of cooked pieces. A freezing gas, pref. carbon dioxide is injected into the agitated prod. e.g. by means of a hollow lance directed into the drum. - The surfaces of the agitated pieces become partially frozen, making the pieces rigid while some moisture is retained on their surfaces. Dry powdered additives are dosed into the rotary drum, pref. continuously via the gas injection lance. The piece of prod. become uniformly coated with additive which adheres to the damp surfaces. Agitation proceeds until the pieces are frozen right through. The pieces are then ready for packing into plastic sacks etc. for storing in freezers. source_text: Thermal energy is supplied to a slag bath from an oxygen steel plant or anelectric steel plant, and substances containing phosphates or capable offorming phosphates are added to said bath. source_text: This invention relates to a general preparation method of silica aluminaxerogels from precursors solubilised in a water-miscible organic solvent.The hydrolysis reaction resulting in the polymerisation of the precursorsand the formation of the gel may be conducted in an acidic or basic medium.The percentage of aluminium in the xerogels formed may vary from 1 to 15%.The notable characteristics of the xerogels produced using this generalpreparation method are a specific surface area (SBET) which reaches 566 m2/gand a pore volume (Vp) of 454 cm3/g for 15% aluminium gels obtained usingthe acidic process and a specific surface area (SBET) of 173 m2/g and a porevolume (Vp) of 320 cm3/g for 15% aluminium gels obtained using the basicprocess.

source_text: Onto a mobile base plate (5) is deposited a layer of finely divided materials (6), constituted by a mixture (M) of iron oxides (1), solid carbonaceous reducing agent (2) and desulphurising agent (3). The layer is heated to cause the at least partial gasification of the solid carbonaceous reducing agent, which causes the release of gaseous compounds of carbon and sulphur. The iron oxides are reduced by means of at least a part of the carbon monoxide (CO) contained in the gaseous carbon compounds and, by means of the desulphurising agent, at least a part of the sulphur contained in the gaseous sulphur compounds is fixed. Lastly the reduced iron oxides and the residues of the solid carbonaceous reducing agent and of the desulphurising agent are separated.<IMAGE>

On chauffe la couche pour provoquer la gazéification au moins partielle de l'agent réducteur carboné solide, ce qui provoque le dégagement de composés gazeux du carbone et du soufre. source_text: The present invention relates to the use of expanded polystyrene and/or non-expanded polystyrene essentially from foodstuff packaging. target_text: Il s'agit d'un nouveau principe qui consiste à produire le pétrole de l'eau de mer au moyen de la formation d'une chaîne carbonique en utilisant des matériaux chimiques industrialisés de coût médiocre. Ainsi il est possible de profiter de tous les éléments de l'eau de mer. Ainsi, nous sommes parvenus à former des hydrocarbonates et en extraire 75% de l'énergie après le raffinage du pétrole. Il faut signaler que les substances chimiques utilisées, nécessaire à la production, sont disponibles dans tous les pays du monde, que la matière première de la production est l'eau de mer. Nous avons également exploité les matériaux pétroliers résultant du raffinage dans le domaine de l'industrie pétrochimique, les autres industries: médicale, agriculturale et humaine. Le coût d'un baril (200 litres) du pétrole brut est moins de 10 dollars américains et il est possible de réaliser le projet sur toutes les côtes latérales du monde et produire la quantité nécessaire à tout pays sous forme d'une matiére brute avant de passer au raffinage.

source_text: A method for producing Si, characterized in that it comprises adding, to an SiO solid, an oxide, a hydroxide, a carbonate or a fluoride of an alkali metal element, or an oxide, a hydroxide, a carbonate or a fluoride of an alkaline earth metal element, or two or more of the above-mentioned compounds in a total molar amount of 1/20 to 1000 times that of the SiO solid to prepare a mixture, heating the mixture to a temperature from the melting point of Si to 2000 ° C, to effect a reaction for forming Si, and separating the resulting Si from reaction by-products for recovery. target_text: Si製造工程等から発生する工業的価値の無かった各種形態の SiO固体から、Siを安価に効率良く製造することを目標として、 SiO固体へ、アルカリ金属元素の酸化物、水酸化物、炭酸化物、フッ化物のいずれか、又はアルカリ土類金属元素の酸化物、水酸化物、炭酸化物、フッ化物のいずれか、又はこれらの化合物の２種以上を、総量のモル数が SiO固体のモル数の１／20以上1000倍以下となる量を添加し、該混合物をSiの融点以上2000℃以下に加熱し、化学反応を行わせることによりSiを生成させ、該Siを反応副生成物から分離回収することを特徴とするSi製造方法を提供する。

source_text: A method of machining a semiconductor wafer-use polishing pad, capable forming grooves, recesses and through holes having an inner surface roughness as small as up to 20 μm, a high dimension accuracy, and a uniform sectional shape; and a semiconductor wafer-use polishing pad. The machining method machines by cutting the polishing surface of a polishing pad having a non-water-soluble matrix containing a cross-linking polymer, and water-soluble particles dispersed in the non-water-soluble matrix. During the machining, it is preferable that the polishing pad be mounted on one surface side of a machining table having a suction hole and sucked from the other surface side of the table to suck and fixed the pad to the one surface side of the table, and then a groove or the like is formed.
target_text: 本発明の目的は、内面の表面粗さが20μm以下と小さく、更には寸法精度が高く、断面形状が均一な溝、凹部、貫通孔等を形成することができる半導体ウェハ用研磨パッドの加工方法及び半導体ウェハ用研磨パッドを提供することにある。本発明の加工方法では、架橋重合体を含有する非水溶性マトリックスと、この非水溶性マトリックス中に分散された水溶性粒子とを有する研磨パッドの研磨面を切削加工等により加工する。また、加工の際には、吸引孔を有する加工テーブルの一面側に研磨パッドを載置し、加工テーブルの他面側から吸引してパッドを加工テーブルの一面側に吸着させて固定した後、溝等を形成することがより好ましい。

source_text: An automobile engine valve mechanism system shim or lifter that slides with a cam lobe on a cam shaft as a mating member, for driving internal combustion engine intake and exhaust valves is disclosed. The surface that slides with the cam lobe as a mating member is coated with a hard carbon thin film, which has a surface hardness, measured in Knoop hardness, of 1500-4500 kg/mm2, a film thickness of 0.3-2.0 μm, and a surface roughness (Ry) [μm] that satisfies the relation Ry < {(0.75 - Hk/8000) × h + 0.07/0.8} ...(A)(h in the expression is the thickness of the hard carbon thin film, in [μm], and Hk is the Knoop hardness of the hard carbon thin film, in [kg/mm2]. There are provided an automobile engine valve mechanism system shim, lifter and a cam shaft combination, superior in friction characteristics and durability, inhibiting film cracking, peeling or the like that occurs when hard thin films, which are considered to have less ductility, are applied to sliding parts, securing durability and reliability, realizing a low friction coefficient.

source_text: Fluorine-containing emulsifiers can be recovered from aqueous liquors containing fluorine-containing emulsifiers in concentrations of as low as 1 ppm by mass to 1 % by mass (for example, wastewaters from the step of flocculation of fluoropolymers following the emulsion polymerization or aqueous washings obtained by water-washing the waste gas from the step of drying of fluoropolymers and/or the step of heat treatment thereof) by vacuum-concentrating such an aqueous liquor by the use of a concentrator of evaporation-on-heating-tube-surface type equipped with a heat pump under a pressure of 100 kPa or below at a liquor temperature of 100°C or below to thereby obtain a concentrated aqueous liquor having a fluorine-containing emulsifier concentration of 5 % by mass or above and recovering the fluorine-containing emulsifier from the concentrated aqueous liquor. According to the invention, fluorine -containing emulsifiers can be recovered with high recovery from liquors containing such emulsifiers in low concentrations, for example, wastewaters from the flocculation of fluoropolymers.

source_text: A method of producing honeycomb structures comprises the steps of putting, for immersion, the end surface of a honeycomb structure (1) in a storage vessel (9) containing slurry (8), pressing it against the inner bottom surface of the storage vessel (9) to thereby force the slurry (8) into at least some of the cells (3) to form pore-sealed portions (2), taking the honeycomb structure (1) having pore-sealed portions (2), out of the storage vessel (9), thereby obtaining the honeycomb structure (1) with at least some of the cells (3) having their pores sealed, the method being characterized in that after an air layer (10) is formed in advance between the pore-sealed portions (2) and the inner bottom surface of the storage vessel (9) to once separate the two from each other, the honeycomb structure (1) formed with pore-sealed portions (2) is taken out of the storage vessel (9).
target_text: 本発明のハニカム構造体の製造方法は、ハニカム構造体１の端面を、スラリー８が貯留された貯留容器９中に浸漬し、貯留容器９の内底面に対して押圧することにより、少なくとも一部のセル３にスラリー８を圧入させて目封じ部２を形成し、次いで、貯留容器９から目封じ部２の形成されたハニカム構造体１を取り出すことによって、少なくとも一部のセル３が目封じされたハニカム構造体１を得るものであり、目封じ部２と貯留容器９の内底面との間に予め空気層１０を形成して、両者を一旦分離した後、貯留容器９から目封じ部２の形成されたハニカム構造体１を取り出すことを特徴とするものである。

source_text: A method of producing flat glass, capable of improving surface smoothness in a movement direction of the flat glass and preventing lines from occurring on the flat glass. Supporting bodies (12) are arranged in such a way that the bodies at least do no move in the direction parallel to the direction of movement of a glass ribbon (13). source_text: A magnetoresistive device having a favorable magnetic characteristic, and a magnetic memory device comprising this magnetoresistive device and having an excellent write/read characteristic are disclosed. A pair of ferromagnetic layer (magnetization pinned layer (5) and a magnetization free layer (7)) are opposed to each other, with an intermediate layer (6) interposed therebetween. The magnetoresistance can be varied by passing a current perpendicularly to the film surface. When the product of the resistivity multiplied by the film thickness of when a current is passed in the direction of the film thickness of the magnetization free layer (7) is defined as a normalized resistance, the normalized resistance of a magnetoresistive device (1) lies in the range from 2,000 to 10,000 Ωnm2. The magnetic memory device comprises such a magnetoresistive device (1), and a bit line and a word line between which the magnetoresistive device (1) is interposed in the direction of thickness.
target_text: 良好な磁気特性を有する磁気抵抗効果素子、及びこの磁気抵抗効果素子を備えて優れた書き込み・読み込み特性を有する磁気メモリ装置を提供する。対の強磁性層(磁化固定層5と磁化自由層7)が中間層6を介して対向され、膜面に対して垂直に電流を流すことによって磁気抵抗変化を得る構成であり、磁化自由層7の膜厚方向に電流を流したときの比抵抗と膜厚との積を規格化抵抗と定義したとき、この規格化抵抗が2000Ωnm2以上、10000Ωnm2以下である磁気抵抗効果素子1、並びにこの磁気抵抗効果素子1と磁気抵抗効果素子1を厚み方向に挟むビット線及びワード線とを備えた磁気メモリ装置を構成する。

source_text: A spark plug having a discharge section composed of a noble metal chip. The spark consumption, oxidation consumption, and abnormal consumption of the discharge section are suppressed, and separation of the noble metal chip from the surface of the discharge section is prevented. The spark plug comprising a center electrode (3) and a ground electrode (4) the side surface of which faces the end portion of the center electrode (3) is characterized in that at least a center electrode noble metal chip (31’) or a ground electrode noble metal chip (32’) is so welded to the corresponding electrode of the center electrode (3) or the ground electrode (4) as to face a spark discharge gap (g), a center electrode discharge section (31) having a center electrode discharge surface (31t) or a ground electrode discharge section (32) having a ground electrode discharge surface (32t) are formed by the welding, and each of the center electrode noble metal chip (31’) and the ground electrode noble metal chip (32’) contains Ir as the main component, Rh, Ni, and at least one of Pt and Pd.
target_text: 本発明の課題は、貴金属チップにて放電部を形成したスパークプラグであって、放電部の火花消耗や酸化消耗、異常消耗を抑制しつつ、放電部表面における貴金属チップの剥離を抑制することができるスパークプラグを提供する。本発明は、中心電極(3)と、その中心電極(3)の先端部に自身の側面が対向するように配置された接地電極(4)とを備え、火花放電ギャップgに対向する位置においてそれら中心電極(3)と接地電極(4)との少なくとも一方に、中心電極側貴金属チップ(31')、接地電極側貴金属チップ(32')を溶接することにより中心電極側放電面(31t)、接地電極側放電面(32t)を有する中心電極側放電部(31)、接地電極側放電部(32)が形成され、中心電極側貴金属チップ(31')、接地電極側貴金属チップ(32')は、主成分としてのIrと、Rhと、Niとを含有し、さらにPt及びPdの少なくともいずれか一方を含有することを特徴とする。

source_text: It is intended to provide a method of analyzing a measurement sample whereby the conditions of a probe located on a support and the occurrence/non-occurrence of the formation of a hybrid of the probe with a target nucleic acid (for example, imaging of the locations and quantitative analysis thereof) can be accurately analyzed. source_text: A semiconductor device having a conducting path of novel structure, which is formed from an organic semiconductor molecule material and shows a high mobility, and method for manufacturing such a semiconductor device. By a functional group at both ends of an organic semiconductor molecule (9) such as 4,4’- biphenyldithiol, fine particles (8) made of a conductor such as Au or a semiconductor and organic semiconductor molecules (9) are alternately linked, thereby forming a conducting path of network structure wherein conducting paths within the fine particles (8) are two-dimensionally or three-dimensionally linked with conducting paths within the organic semiconductor molecules (9). In this conducting path, there occurs no move of electrons between molecules and the mobility is not restricted by such move of electrons between molecules. Consequently, the mobility of the conducting path along the main chain of the organic semiconductor molecule (which is in the direction of molecular axis), for example the high mobility of non-localized ? electrons within molecule can be utilized to the maximum.
target_text: 有機半導体分子を材料として形成される導電路が新規な構造を有し、高い移動度を示す半導体装置及びその製造方法である。4,4'-ビフェニルジチオール等の有機半導体分子（９）の両端にある官能基によって、Au等の導体又は半導体からなる微粒子（８）と有機半導体分子（９）とを交互に結合させ、微粒子（８）内の導電路と有機半導体分子（９）内の導電路とが二次元または三次元的に連結されたネットワーク型の導電路を形成する。この導電路には、分子間の電子移動が含まれず、移動度が分子間の電子移動によって制限されることがないので、有機半導体分子内の主鎖に沿った（分子の軸方向の）導電路の移動度、例えば非局在化したπ電子による高い分子内移動度を最大限に利用することができる。

source_text: An inexpensive object having a hard coating excellent in antifouling properties, lubricity, marring resistance, and wearing resistance; and a method of forming a hard coating. A hard coating material composition containing an actinic-energy-ray-curable compound is applied to a surface of an object (1) to be coated with a hard coating layer to thereby form a layer of the hard coating material composition. A film of a surface material comprising a fluorinated polyfunctional (meth)acrylate compound and a fluorinated monofunctional (meth)acrylate compound is formed on the layer of the hard coating material composition to form a layer of the surface material. The layer of the hard coating material composition and the surface material layer thus formed are irradiated with actinic energy rays to simultaneously cure both layers. Thus, a hard coating layer (2) in contact with the surface of the object (1) and an antifouling surface layer (3) in contact with the surface of the hard coating layer (2) are formed.
target_text: 防汚性及び潤滑性と、耐擦傷性及び耐摩耗性とに優れたハードコートが付与された物体を安価に提供し、ハードコートの形成方法を提供する。ハードコート処理すべき対象物体1表面に、活性エネルギー線硬化性化合物を含むハードコート剤組成物を塗布してハードコート剤組成物層を形成し、ハードコート剤組成物層表面上に、フッ素を含有する多官能(メタ)アクリレート化合物とフッ素を含有する単官能(メタ)アクリレート化合物とを含む表面材料を成膜して表面材料層を形成し、形成されたハードコート剤組成物層及び表面材料層に活性エネルギー線を照射して、前記両層を同時に硬化させ、対象物体1表面に接するハードコート層2とハードコート層2表面に接する防汚表面層3とを形成する。

source_text: A water-soluble polymer dispersion, a process for producing the same and a method of use therefor. In particular, the water-soluble polymer dispersion is one comprising water-soluble polymer fine particles of 100 μm or less diameter having at least one ionic property selected from among cationic, amphoteric, nonionic and anionic properties together with a polyalkyleneimine and/or a product of polyalkyleneimine modification wherein according to necessity an appropriate amount of water-soluble inorganic salt is incorporated. The provided process enables easily performing the production in dispersed form by means of production facilities of low cost. The obtained water-soluble polymer dispersion is excellent in storage stability and exhibits satisfactory fluidity and solubility so as to enable use in papermaking raw material pretreatments added to papermaking raw materials prior to machine operation and also for enhancement of freeness, increase of sizing degree and enhancement of retention. Further use can be found in incorporation in an organic sludge or paper mill sludge for flocculation and ensuing drainage.
target_text: 本発明は、水溶性重合体分散液、その製造方法およびその使用方法に関するものであり、詳しくは、カチオン性、両性、非イオン性およびアニオン性から選択される一種以上のイオン性を有する粒径１００μm以下の水溶性重合体微粒子とポリアルキレンイミンおよび／またはポリアルキレンイミン変性物とが共存し、更に必要に応じて必要量の水溶性無機塩類が共存する水溶性重合体分散液であり、本発明の製造方法により、低コストの製造設備で分散液の形態で容易に製造することができ、そして、得られた本発明の水溶性重合体分散液は、貯蔵安定性に優れ、且つ、流動性や溶解性が良く、抄紙前の製紙原料中に添加する製紙原料前処理、濾水性の向上、サイズ度の向上、歩留向上に使用可能であり、更に有機汚泥あるいは製紙スラッジに添加し、凝集後、脱水処理に応用することができる。

source_text: A highly tough diamond substrate of large area and high quality for use in semiconductor materials, electronic components, optical parts, etc.; and a process for producing the same. A diamond composite substrate is produced by superimposing a diamond polycrystal film on a surface of diamond single-crystal substrate. With respect to this diamond composite substrate, it is preferred that plane opposite in parallel relationship to the main plane of largest area of diamond single-crystal substrate as {100} plane be formed by the superimposed diamond polycrystal film. Diamond composite substrate (2) may be provided by forming diamond single-crystal substrate (3) from multiple diamond single crystals with the orientations of main planes uniformalized and joining the multiple diamond single crystals by means of diamond polycrystal layer (4). Further, using the diamond single crystals as seed crystals, diamond single crystals formed by a vapor-phase synthesis may be superimposed on a surface thereof.
target_text: 本発明の目的は、半導体材料、電子部品、光学部品などに用いられる、高靱性でかつ、大面積・高品質なダイヤモンド基板及びその製造法を提供することである。 ダイヤモンド単結晶基板の表面にダイヤモンド多結晶膜を積層させてダイヤモンド複合基板とする。該複合基板は、ダイヤモンド単結晶基板の最も面積の大きい主たる面を｛１００｝面とし、この面に平行な対面に、前記ダイヤモンド多結晶膜が積層されていることが好ましい。該ダイヤモンド単結晶基板３を、主たる面の面方位が揃った複数個のダイヤモンド単結晶体から構成し、これら複数個のダイヤモンド単結晶体を該ダイヤモンド多結晶層４によって接合してダイヤモンド複合基板２としてもよい。また、該ダイヤモンド単結晶を種結晶として、その表面に気相合成ダイヤモンド単結晶を設けても良い。
