source_text: The present invention discloses traditional Chinese medicine tablets for treating hyperlipidemia, and a preparation method of the traditional Chinese medicine tablets. The tablets of the present invention are prepared from hawthorn (whose kernel is removed), prepared fleeceflower root, semen cassiae torae and lotus leaf. The semen cassiae torae and the hawthorn are put in water to be decocted for two times, and the semen cassiae torae and the hawthorn are decocted for 2 hours every time; the decocted solutions are mixed and filtered, and then, the filtered solution is concentrated into paste; the lotus leaf and the prepared fleeceflower root are extracted for three times by ethanol whose concentration is 50% in a refluxing mode, the ethanol is recovered and concentrated into paste, and then, the filtered solution paste and the ethanol paste are mixed; the pressure of the mixture is reduced, and the mixture is dried and pulverized into fine powder; a proper quantity of pre-gelatinizing starch and sodium carboxymethyl starch are added into the fine powder to be evenly mixed, the mixture is granulated by ethanol whose concentration is 75%, dried and pressed into tablets, and then, films are coated on the tablets to form finished products. The tablets of the present invention farthest keep effective components, and are convenient to take; the tablets of the present invention can be used for many people to take, and the dosage is accurate. Because the films which can be dissolved in the stomach are coated on the tablets, the stability of the tablets is improved; meanwhile, the bitterness of original medicines can be eliminated. The tablets of the present invention have the efficiency of reducing blood fat and softening blood vessels, and is used for enhancing the blood circulation of the coronary artery and resisting arrhythmia and hyperlipidemia.
target_text: 本发明公开了一种治疗高血脂症的中药片剂及其制备方法。它是由山楂(去核)、制何首乌、决明子、荷叶组成。决明子、山楂加水煎煮二次，每次2小时，合并煎液，滤过，滤液浓缩成膏；其余荷叶、制何首乌用50%乙醇回流提取三次，回收乙醇，浓缩成膏，与上述浓缩膏合并，减压干燥，粉碎成细粉，加入预胶化淀粉、羧甲基淀粉钠适量，混匀，用75%乙醇制粒，干燥压片，包薄膜衣，即得成品。本发明的片剂最大限度地保留了有效成分，服用方便，服用人群广，且用药量准确；采用胃溶型薄膜包衣，提高药物的稳定性，同时可掩原药的苦味。具有降血脂，软化血管。用于增强冠状动脉血液循环，抗心律不齐及高血脂症。

source_text: The present invention belongs to medical preparations, which relates to a nanometer preparation for treating Parkinson disease and Parkinson syndrome, which is formed by using levodopa as the effective component and using a high molecular polymer as the carrier. The nanometer preparation of the present invention is formed by that a parent aqueous block polymer (PEO-b-PAA) is synthesized by using the one step method and the LD carrying nanometer particles are prepared so as to obtain the levodopa nanometer preparation. Both PEO and PAA are certified by the ADSL, and obtain the FDA approval that the PEO and the PAA can be used in human bodies; the animal experiment verifies that the peak value of the concentration of blood dopamine is obviously reduced after the present invention is used in animals, and the peak value of block dopamine in brains is 500 to 600 times of that of a common preparation for more than 28 days; a polymer micellar solution with fixed structure, the concentration of which reaches 20%, is prepared by using the one step method; the present invention lays foundations for industrial production of LD carrying nanometer particles on large scale.
target_text: 本发明属于医用制剂，涉及一种以左旋多巴为有效成份，以高分子聚合物为载体，治疗帕金森病及帕金森综合症的纳米制剂，首先采用一步法合成双亲水性嵌段共聚物PEO-b-PAA，然后进行载LD纳米粒子的制备；得到左旋多巴纳米制剂。PEO和PAA均已经过ADSL认证，得到FDA批准可运用于人体；动物试验证实使用该制剂后，血多巴胺浓度峰值有明显下降，而脑内的状体多巴胺峰值可达普通制剂的500～600倍，时间长达28天以上；且一步法制备出结构固定、浓度高达20%的聚合物胶束溶液；为载LD纳米粒子的大规模工业化生产奠定了基础。

source_text: Tegafur-gimeracil-potassium oxonate which comprises tegafur, gimeracil and potassium oxonate is an antitumor drug with high efficiency and low toxicity, but the symptoms, such as the gastritis, the vomitus, the anorexia, etc., of most patients still occur. source_text: The present invention relates to the technical field of medicines, which is a compound electrolyte fructose injection widely used after an operation and particularly to a kidney transplanting operation in a diuresis stage for fluid supplementing treatment. The present invention changes the existing scheme that different liquid is gradually input, fructose is used for replacing dextrose according to each component of supplement fluid after an operation, a proper concentration range is selected to prepare the compound injection, and the capability of an infusion bottle or an infusion bag is properly enlarged. Thereby, an infusion operation program is simplified, the workload of the fluid supplementing treatment is reduced, and pollution and errors possibly caused by frequently replacing the infusion bottle or the infusion bag are also overcome. The supply of machine body energy can be ensured by using the fructose for replacing the dextrose, blood sugar rise after the operation can also be reduced, and the present invention is favorable for lightening renal burdens and is also suitable for diabetics' fluid supplement after the operation.

source_text: The present invention discloses the novel purpose of astragalus saponin A, namely the novel application to the preparation of medicines, and actually relates to the application of astragalus saponin A to the perparation of a medicine for treating diabetic peripheral neuropathy. Experimental research of pharmacodynamics proves that bendazac lysine has very obvious functions of lowering blood sugar and glycosylated hemoglobin and promoting the secretion of insulin, and can increase the activity of sciatic nerve GSH-PX and inhibit the activity of COX-2. BDL has obvious antioxidation and antiinflammatory functions to a DPN rat. source_text: The present invention relates to rhododendron dauricum extract and an extraction method thereof. Measurement of the rhododendron dauricum extract, which is carried out with hyperin as a representative component shows that the extract contains 30 to 90 wt% of flavone, 6.3 to 42 wt% of hyperin compounds, 0.4 to 8 wt% of rhododendrin compounds and 0.7 to 7 wt% of quercetin compounds. The extraction method adopts separation columns of polyamide resin, and clarification and purification are carried out for column applying liquid by clarificant. The present invention is characterized in that the rhododendron dauricum extract is a novel substance which is firstly extracted from rhododendron dauricum, not only is the refining degree high, most of the pharmacological activity of the rhododendron dauricum is also reserved, and the dosage is much less than the crude extract of the rhododendron dauricum; the pharmacological performance and the medicine performance of the present invention are obviously better than those of the crude extract. The extraction method adopts the polyamide resin as separation means, and a large number of impurities can be removed, so the present invention enriches effective components and has low cream yield rate.
target_text: 本发明为一种满山红提取物及其提取方法。满山红提取物，(1)以金丝桃苷作为代表成分对该提取物进行测定，提取物中总黄酮含量30%-90%；(2)提取物中，金丝桃苷化合物的含量6.3%-42%；(3)提取物中，杜鹃素化合物的含量0.4%-8%；(4)提取物中，槲皮素化合物的含量0.7%-7%。提取方法采用聚酰胺树脂分离柱，并用澄清剂对上柱液进行澄清、纯化。本发明所表征的满山红提取物是首次从满山红中提取出来的一种新物质，不仅精制程度高，而且保留了大部分满山红的药理活性，而且服用量远小于满山红粗体物，其药理、药性与满山红粗提物相比有显著区别。提取方法采用聚酰胺树脂作为分离手段，可除去大量杂质，因而使有效成分富集、出膏率低。

source_text: The present invention discloses horn removing ointment for a milk cow, which is invented aiming at overcoming the defects that the existing milk cow horn removing technology by an etching method and cauterization has the disadvantages of complicated method and inconvenient operation and is easy to hurt a person and a milk cow, etc. The present invention is characterized in that the present invention is white or hoary cream prepared by that java brucea fruit extract, sodium hydroxide, slaked lime and an excipient are mixed according to a weight proportion of 3: 1: 4: 2, and agitated with water. The present invention is evenly smeared on the convex part of the horns of a calf. The calf does not suffer from pain and is scarless, and clothing hair grows normally; a milk cow grows horns no longer for a whole life by being smeared with the present invention one time, and an effective rate is 100%. The present invention has the advantages of safety, reliability, simple operation and convenient use, and can be used by everyone. The application operation of the present invention can be done by one person. A great amount of manpower, material resources and financial resources can be saved. The present invention is convenient for a dairy farm to popularize in a large-area mode, and is convenient for an individual dispersing culturist to use alone.

source_text: The externally applied sterilizing Mongolian medicine lotion for skin and genitals is an externally applied sterilizing Mongolian medicine lotion for preventing and treating skin mucous membrane and general male and female genitals infection, and is characterized by being prepared from the following compatible raw material medicines: sophora alopecuroide, myrobalan, szechwan chinaberry fruit, fructus cnidii, alum, pearl and borneol. The preparation method comprises adding water 10 times of the amount of the medicinal materials, decocting, filtering to remove residue, and collecting decoction. The general application method is as follows: diluting with water at a ratio of 5%, and soaking or scrubbing the affected part for a certain time, once a day until the affected part is cured. The invention has the main advantages that: the traditional Chinese medicine composition has the advantages of high cure rate, low cost, strong pertinence and no toxic or side effect, can be used at home at any time, can be used as a household stock health-care medicine, and can achieve the prevention purpose by scrubbing occasionally.
target_text: 皮肤及生殖器外用消毒蒙药洗剂，是一种预防和治疗皮肤黏膜、男女生殖器一般性感染的外用消毒蒙药洗液，其特征在于，是由下述配伍的原料药制成：苦豆子，诃子，川楝子，蛇床子，白矾，珍珠，冰片。其制法，配水10倍于药量，煎煮后滤渣取汁而成。一般使用方法为：按5%的比例用水稀释后，浸泡或擦洗患处一定时间即可，每日一次至痊愈。本发明的主要优点：治愈率高，花钱少，针对性强，无毒副作用，可随时在家使用，可作为家庭常备保健类药品，不定时的进行一些擦洗可达到预防目的。

source_text: The present invention relates to a traditional Chinese medicine preparation for treating fractures and traumatic injuries, which is composed of leaflet schefflera octophylla, twotooth achyranthes root, curare, cassia twig, red peony root and liquoric root. The present invention has a production method that the raw materials are manufactured according to a conventional production method of Chinese traditional patent medicine. Various preparations comprise oral administration traditional Chinese medicine decoction, medicinal wine, medicinal powder, capsules, pills, leaching agents, external ointments, liniment, etc. The traditional Chinese medicine preparation has the efficinecy of pain elimination, blood circulation activation and channel dredging. If a patient takes medicine according to medical orders, the present invention has no side effect for the body of the patient. The coaptation secret prescription has the advantages of obvious and positive curative effect, high curative effect and short treatment period. Fractures generally can be cured in about 60 days when the fractures have no displacement, and fractures generally can be cured in about 90 days when the fractures have displacement. A fracture patient basically does not need various traction nursing care means, operation for needle penetration and positioning, and corresponding treatment. Because the present invention has the characteristics of short treatment and medication time, obvious effect, low price of medicine, etc., the present invention is welcomed by patients.
target_text: 本发明的治疗骨折及跌打损伤的中药制剂，是由小叶鹅掌柴、牛膝、马钱子、桂枝、赤芍、甘草所组成，其生产方法为按照中药成药的常规生产方法进行制作，各种制剂指内服中药汤剂、药酒、散剂、胶囊剂、丸剂、浸出剂、外用的药膏、搽剂等，这种中药制剂，具有祛痛、活血、通络的功效，如照医嘱服药，对用药人身体无副作用，此接骨秘方具有显著、肯定的疗效，治愈率很高，且治疗期短，对骨折未移位骨折，一般在60天左右可以治愈，骨折如果有移位，一般在90天左右可以治愈，基本上不需要各种牵引护理手段，和不需进行手术穿针定位及相应的治疗，由于有治疗用药的时间较短，见效快，药品的价格低廉等特点，很受患者欢迎。

source_text: The present invention belongs to a medicinal preparation for treating hemorrhoids, which is composed of raw materials of the following parts by weight: 1 to 3 of alum, 1 to 2 of verdigris, 13 to 23 of sophora fruit, 4 to 8 of cyrtomium rhizome, 1 to 3 of borneol, 10 to 16 of garden burnet root, 20 to 30 of fig, 0.4 to 0.8 of metronidazole and 0.001 to 0.002 of dexamethasone. The medicine of the present invention treats hemorrhoids by the combination of external immersion and external adhesion at affected parts. The medicine has the functions of quickly stopping bleeding, relieving itch and eliminating swelling and is capable of radically curing hemorrhoids without relapse. In addition, the medicine has the advantages of simple use and no toxic or side effect.

source_text: The present invention relates to a preparation method of a traditional Chinese medicine preparation of a deer horn preparation which is also named as a xinsheng preparation, and is used for treating chronic congestive heart failure. The preparation is prepared from a prescription which comprises the following raw materials of the proportion by weight: 1% to 5% of deer horn glue or 8% to 25% of sliced deer horn, 15% to 40% of epimedium herb, 15% to 40% of glossy privet fruit, 10% to 30% of psoralea fruit, 8% to 25% of cornel and 8% to 25% of dried tangerine peel. The preparation method comprises: taking extract obtained by decocting the components of the prescription except for deer horn with water, removing impurities with high speed centrifugation, concentrating and spray-drying supernatant fluid to obtain powdered extract and adding deer horn powder and medicinal auxiliary materials to the powdered extract; then, an oral preparation is prepared by a conventional preparation method. The deer horn preparation (xinsheng preparation) prepared by the method of the present invention has the advantages of high content of active ingredients, convenient preparation and definite therapeutic effect, and is especially suitable for industrial production.
target_text: 本发明涉及一种治疗慢性充血性心力衰竭的中药制剂(鹿角方制剂，又名心盛制剂)的制备方法。该方法以重量百分比配方为鹿角胶1%-5%或鹿角片8%-25%、淫羊藿15%-40%、女贞子15%-40%、补骨脂10%-30%、山茱萸8%-25%和陈皮8%-25%原料，取配方中除鹿角外其余组分水煎煮后的提取液，高速离心去除杂质，上清液浓缩，喷雾干燥得浸膏粉；加入鹿角粉和药用辅料按常规制剂方法制成口服制剂。用本发明方法制备的鹿角方制剂(心盛制剂)，活性成份含量高，制剂方便，疗效确切，特别适合于产业化生产。

source_text: The present invention discloses a Chinese medicine composition for treating baldness and a preparing method thereof. The Chinese medicine composition for treating baldness is made of 74 portions of rehmanniae, 74 portions of mature rehmanniae, 74 portions of prepared fleeceflower roots, 49 portions of red sage roots, 49 portions of fried white peony roots, 25 portions of aqueous extracts of pawpaw, 49 portions of angelica, 49 portions of schisandra, 25 portions of volatile oil clathrate compounds of notopterygium roots, the mixture of the aqueous extracts and supplementary material. The preparing method comprises the steps that a), the material is weighed proportionally; b), volatile oil is extracted from the angelica, the schisandra and the notopterygium roots by an aqueous distillation method for obtaining the volatile oil 1 and filter liquor 2; after water is added in medicine dregs and is decocted, filter liquor 3 is obtained; c), the water is added in the rehmanniae, the mature rehmanniae, the prepared fleeceflower roots, the red sage roots, the fried white peony roots and the pawpaw and is decocted twice for obtaining filter liquor 4; d), the filter liquor 2, the filter liquor 3 and the filter liquor 4 are merged, concentrated and dried for obtaining a dry extract 5; the volatile oil 1 is packed by beta-cyclodextrin for obtaining a volatile oil packing article 6; f), after the dry extract 5 is added in the supplementary material and is made into granules, the dry extract 5 is dried; the volatile oil packing article 6 and the supplementary material are added and pressed into a sheet or are filled into a capsule. The present invention has the advantages of high bioavailability of medicine material, good medicine effect, less dosage and convenient transportation and carrying.
target_text: 本发明公开了一种治疗脱发的中药组合物及其制备方法，由74份地黄、74份熟地黄、74份制何首乌、49份丹参、49份炒白芍、25份木瓜的水提物，49份当归、49份五味子、25份羌活的挥发油包合物和水提物加辅料制成。方法是：a)按比例称重；b)当归、五味子、羌活用水蒸馏法提取挥发油，得挥发油1和滤液2，药渣加水煎煮后得滤液3；c)地黄、熟地黄、制何首乌、丹参、炒白芍、木瓜加水煎煮两次得滤液4；d)滤液2、滤液3和滤液4合并浓缩干燥得干浸膏5；e)挥发油1用β-环糊精包合得挥发油包合物6；f)干浸膏5加入辅料制成颗粒后干燥，加挥发油包合物6和辅料，压制成片或填装成胶囊。本发明具有药材的生物利用率高、药效好、服用量少、运输携带方便的优点。

source_text: The present invention relates to traditional Chinese medicine for preventing and curing recurrent respiratory tract infection. The present invention is characterized in that the present invention is prepared from 10 to 20g of astragalus root, 6 to 12g of heterophylly falsestarwort root, 6 to 12g of rehmannia root, 12 to 24g of shiitake fungus and 2 to 4g of liquorice. The astragalus root and the heterophylly falsestarwort root in a prescription are sweet in flavor and slightly warm in nature. The astragalus root and the heterophylly falsestarwort root enter the lung and the spleen channel for invigorating qi of the spleen and the lung and are sovereign medicine. Red sage root is bitter in taste, is slightly warm in nature, activates blood circulation, removes blood stasis and is auxiliary medicine. The rehmannia root has two functions: on one hand, the function of removing pathogenic heat from blood is used for assisting the blood circulation activation and blood stasis removal; on the other hand, the rehmannia root is sweet in flavor and cold in nature and can be used for curing the sweet nature and warm nature of other kinds of medicine in the prescription. The shiitake fungus supports the healthy energy, supplements vacuity, strengthens the spleen and promotes appetite, and the shiitake fungus and the rehmannia root are auxiliary medicine. The liquorice moistens the lung, arrests cough and adjusts other kinds of medicine as auxiliary medicine. The medicine in prescription has the function of tonifying the lung and the spleen, benefiting qi and activating blood circulation. By the certification of modern medicine theory and research, the heterophylly falsestarwort root, the rehmannia root, the shiitake fungus and the liquorice can adjust and enhance immunological function, have the action of resisting pathogenic animalcules and have good curing effect for curing asthenia of qi in the lung and the spleen and blood stasis of recurrent respiratory tract infection.
target_text: 一种防治小儿反复呼吸道感染的中药，其特点是由黄芪10～20g、丹参3～9g、太子参6～12g、生地6～12g、香菇12～24g、甘草2～4g配制成。本方中黄芪、太子参均味甘性微温，入肺、脾经，内可大补脾肺之气，外可固表止汗，两药共为君药。丹参味苦性微温，活血祛淤为臣。生地功用有二，一方面取其清热凉血之功助丹参活血化瘀，一方面其味甘性寒可佐制方中他药的甘温之性。香菇扶正补虚、健脾开胃与生地共为佐。甘草即可润肺止咳，又可调和诸药为使。全方共奏补益肺脾、益气活血之功。现代药理研究证明黄芪、太子参、生地、香菇、甘草均能调整并增强免疫功能，而且还有对抗病原微生物的作用，对治疗小儿反复呼吸道感染之肺脾气虚夹瘀型有很好的疗效。

source_text: The present invention discloses a Chinese traditional medicine for curing cholestatic hepatitis and a preparing method thereof. The Chinese traditional medicine of the present invention has the components by weight percentage: 5% to 80% of red peony root, 5% to 40% of radix rehmanniae, 5% to 50% of moutan bark, 0 to 40% of figwort root, 0 to 15% of liquorice and 0 to 20% of buffalo horn. The Chinese traditional medicine of the present invention combines a traditional Chinese medicine theory with a modern pharmaceutical research result; the red peony root is used as a main material; the radix rehmanniae and the moutan bark are used as assistant materials and are used for reinforcing the efficacy of cooling, activating and dissipating blood of the red peony root; the figwort root, the buffalo horn and the liquorice are used as the assistant materials; all the medicines are compounded and exert functions so that the Chinese traditional medicine of the present invention has the functions of resisting hepatic injury, improving hepatic microcirculation, benefiting the gallbladder, promoting bile excretion and quickly removing jaundice; the present invention has an obvious effect on curing cholestatic hepatitis.
target_text: 本发明公开了一种用于治疗淤胆型肝炎的中药及其制备方法。本发明中药按重量百分比计的组份是：赤芍5%—80%、生地5%—40%、牡丹皮5%—50%、玄参0—40%、甘草0—15%、水牛角0—20%。本发明中药将传统的中医理论与现代药学研究结果相结合，重用赤芍以其为君，辅以生地牡丹皮，用于加强赤芍凉血活血散血之功效，佐以玄参、水牛角，甘草为使，诸药为伍相得益彰，使本发明中药具有抗肝损伤、改善肝脏微循环、利胆、促进胆汁排泄迅速退黄的作用，对治疗淤胆型肝炎有非常显著的效果。

source_text: The present invention relates to conductive liquid with the functions of dispelling wind and benefiting the bones, which belongs to the technical field of a traditional Chinese medicine preparation and a preparation method thereof. target_text: 祛风益骨电导液，属于中药制剂及其制备方法技术领域，本发明是一项中药现代化的新项目，提供一种用于现代医疗技术——离子导入疗法治疗骨病、风湿、类风湿的新特药及其制作方法，克服现有治疗骨病、风湿、类风湿常规用药副作用大的弊端，病灶局部药物浓度比常规用药高十几倍至几十倍，因而提高其疗效。本发明的科学含量包括精选含正离子有效成份的中药；在煎煮提取的中药液中加入离子活化剂；用乙醇净化析沉法净化成溶液；加入洋金花做透皮药可顺利导入皮下。生产工艺采用煎煮提取法。主要优点是作用迅速、渗透力强、局部药物浓度高、保持时间长、药效发挥好、无副作用，解决了椎间盘等关节软组织常规用药不能到位的难题。

source_text: The present invention relates to a rheumatism treating medicine composition, a preparation method thereof and application thereof. The rheumatism treating medicine composition is paste which is prepared from the following raw material components: 65 to 75 portions of water, 15 to 25 portions of milled rice, 5 to 15 portions of magnesium chloride, 5 to 15 portions of potassium chloride, 1 to 3 portions of Chinese wolfberry, 1 to 3 portions of cockroach, 1 to 3 portions of centipedes, 1 to 3 portions of earthworms and 1 to 3 portions of scorpion. The preparation method of the rheumatism treating medicine composition comprises the following steps: the water, the pulverized and sieved milled rice, the pulverized and sieved magnesium chloride and the pulverized and sieved potassium chloride are mixed; the mixture of the four materials is continuously preheated for 4 to 6 hours under the temperature of 40 to 60 DEG C; the preheated mixture is gradually heated to the temperature of 60 to 80 DEG C and is persistently heated for 4 to 6 hours to form a paste body; the paste body is cooled and is thoroughly mixed with the pulverized and sieved Chinese wolfberry, the pulverized and sieved cockroach, the pulverized and sieved centipedes, the pulverized and sieved earthworms and the pulverized and sieved scorpion, and then the rheumatism treating medicine composition is obtained. The present invention has no toxic and side effect on patients and also has the advantages of significant treating effect, short treating course, low treating expense and easy use.
target_text: 本发明涉及一种治疗风湿病的药物组合物及其制备方法和应用，是由包括以下原料组分制备而成的膏剂，水65-75、大米15-25、氯化镁5-15、氯化钾5-15、枸杞1-3、土鳖虫1-3、蜈蚣1-3、地龙1-3、全蝎1-3。将水、经粉碎过筛后的大米、氯化镁和氯化钾混合；将上述混合物在40-60℃下连续预热4-6小时；将上述预热的混合物逐渐加热至60-80℃，持续加热4-6小时，制成膏体；将上述膏体冷却，与经粉碎过筛后的枸杞、土鳖虫、蜈蚣、地龙、全蝎再充分混合，即得。本发明对患者无任何毒副作用，具有疗效显著、疗程短、治疗费用低、易于使用的优点。

source_text: The present invention relates to a pure traditional Chinese medicine honey pill for treating kidney diseases and preparation technique thereof, which provides a medicine preparation for treating kidney diseases and a preparation technique thereof. The medicine preparation is prepared from fifteen traditional Chinese medicines, such as milkvetch root, dodder seed, black alum, etc. The preparation method of the pure traditional Chinese medicine honey pill for treating kidney diseases comprises the four steps: mixing medicine powder; decocting the medicine powder into thick paste; stirring the thick paste into pills; sterilizing and subpackaging the pills. The pure traditional Chinese medicine honey pill has the advantages of scientific formula, simple and convenient preparation process and low cost, and has the functions of tonifying the kidney, promoting urination, supplying qi, securing the exterior, nourishing the liver, moistening the lung, warning the spleen, promoting digestion, benefiting blood, quieting heart spirit, eliminating blood stasis and regenerating new blood. Besides the pure traditional Chinese medicine honey pill has obvious treatment effects on protein urine, bloody urine, edema, etc. caused by acute and chronic nephritis, diabetes kidney diseases, hypertension kidney diseases, henoch-schonlein purpura nephritis and nephrotic syndromes.
target_text: 本发明治疗肾病纯中药蜜丸及其制备工艺，提供了治疗肾病的药剂及其生产工艺，其中药制剂由黄芪、菟丝子、黑矾等十五味中药材制成，制备治疗肾病纯中药蜜丸的方法是采用拌制粉药、煎煮稠膏、混拌制丸、灭菌分装四道工艺制成，治疗肾病纯中药蜜丸配方科学，制备工艺简便，成本低廉，具有益肾利尿、补气固表、滋肝润肺、温脾健胃和益精血、安心神、祛瘀血、生新血的功效，对急慢性肾炎、糖尿病肾病、高血压肾病、紫癜性肾炎和肾病综合症引起的尿蛋白、血尿、水肿等症均有显著的疗效。

source_text: The present invention discloses a compound traditional Chinese medicinal preparation for preventing and treating a uterus abnormal bleeding disease and a preparation method thereof. In the preparation method, 54.6g to 101.4g of notoginseng is crushed, alcohol is added to the notoginseng and extracted for two times by reflux, the extracting solution is combined and filtered, and the filtered liquid is decompressed for recovering the alcohol for standby; medicine dregs and 136.5g to 253.5g of madder root, 109.2g to 202.8g of cattail pollen, 273g to 507g of garden burnet root, 81.9g to 152.1g of baical skullcap root, 136.5g to 253.5g of rehmannia root, 273g to 507g of hairyvein agrimonia herb, 273g to 507g of cuttlebone, 163.8g to 304.2g of tangshen, 136.5g to 253.5g of white peony root and 54.6g to 101.4g of liquorice root are decocted for two times by adding water; decocted liquid is combined and filtered, the filtered liquid is concentrated to a clear ointment, the alcohol is added to the ointment, the ointment is refrigerated and filtered, the filtered liquid is decompressed for recovering the alcohol, the alcohol is combined with the extracting solution of the notoginseng, the combined liquid is decompressed and concentrated to a clear ointment, dextrin and steviosin or cane sugar are added to the clear ointment, the dextrin, the steviosin or the cane sugar, and the clear ointment are evenly stirred, dried by spray, granulated and dried. Thereby, the medicine is prepared. The present invention has obvious curative effects on treating uterus abnormal bleeding caused by IUD, woman bleeding caused by medicine abortion, postpartum bleeding, bleeding after induced abortion or menoxenia. The present invention has the advantage of simple technology and is suitable for industrial production.

source_text: The present invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine composition for resisting gout and a preparation method thereof. The composition is prepared from 90 shares of rhubarb, 30 shares of ethanol extract of tetrandria root, 60 shares of plantain seed, 60 shares of oriental waterplantain rhizome, 60 shares of water extract of medicinal cyathula root and general supplementary materials with appropriate quantity. In the preparation method, a. weighing is carried out to the weight proportion; b. tetrandria root is pulverized into crude powder and is heated and is extracted fro two times through backflow with 95% of ethanol, and dry extract 1 is obtained by vacuum dryness after filtrate is concentrated; c. rhubarb is heated and is extracted for two times through backflow with 70% of ethanol, and filtrate 2 is obtained through filtration; d. plantain seed, oriental waterplantain rhizome and medicinal cyathula root are decocted for two times with water, and filtrate 3 is obtained through filtration; e. the filtrate 2 and the filtrate 3 are merged, and dry extract 4 is obtained by drying after pressure reduction and concentration; f. the dry extract 1 and the dry extract 4 are mixed, supplementary materials with appropriate quantity are added, and granules are prepared and are pressed into tablets or encapsulated. The present invention has the advantages of high bioavailability of medicinal materials, good medicine effect and small dose.
target_text: 本发明公开了一种抗痛风的中药组合物及其制备方法，是由90份大黄、30份防己的乙醇提取物和60分车前子、60份泽泻、60份川牛膝的水提取物加适量常用辅料制成。制备方法是：a)按重量比例称重；b)防己粉碎成粗粉，用95%乙醇加热回流提取二次，滤液经浓缩后真空干燥得干浸膏1；c)大黄用70%乙醇加热回流提取二次，过滤得滤液2；d)车前子、泽泻、川牛膝三味加水煎煮二次，过滤得滤液3；e)滤液2与滤液3合并，减压浓缩后干燥得干浸膏4；f)混合干浸膏1、干浸膏4，加入适量辅料，制成颗粒，压制成片或填装成胶囊。本发明具有药材的生物利用率高、药效好、服用量较少的优点。

source_text: The present invention relates to a method for preparing ointment for treating bedsore and promoting tissue regeneration, which belongs to the technical field of methods for preparing traditional Chinese medicine ointment. A conventional western medicine exchange method for treating bedsore, which is previously used, has the defects of long treatment courses, poor therapeutic effect and slow healing. The present invention has a technical scheme that angelica, baical skullcap root, red peony root, safflower, alkanna tinctoria, dahurian angelica, honeysuckle stem, notoginseng powder, rhubarb, gypsum, lonicera confusa DC, indigowoad leaf, dragon blood, borneol, beeswax and sesame oil are used, and the angelica, the baical skullcap root, the dahurian angelica, the rhubarb, the red peony root, the safflower, the alkanna tinctoria, the honeysuckle stem, the lonicera confusa DC and the indigowoad leaf which are prepared are added to the sesame oil to be soaked for 24 hours; the mixture is heated by mild fire to 100 DEG C and maintained for 20 to 30 minutes, medicine dregs are filtered, and the beeswax is added and agitated until the mixture is completely dissolved; when the mixture is condensed to 60 DEG C to 70 DEG C more or less, the gypsum is added and agitated, and the dragon blood, the borneol and the notoginseng powder which are comminuted are subsequently added; the mixture is uniformly agitated, and the ointment for treating bedsore and promoting tissue regeneration is made. The present invention has the advantages that the ointment improves curative rates, shortens treatment courses and alleviates pain without adverse reaction; the method is simple and economical.

source_text: The present invention relates to a Yehua medicinal capsule for treating gynecological inflammation, and a preparation method thereof, which belongs to a Chinese patent medicine and the field of pharmacy. The Yehua medicinal capsule for treating gynecological inflammation comprises raw material medicines or effective components extracted from the raw material medicines. The raw material medicines comprises components according to a proportion by mass: 10 parts of honeysuckle flower, 5 to 7 parts of weeping forsythia capsule, 11 to 13 parts of astragalus root, 4 to 5 parts of tree peony bark, 5 to 7 parts of indigowoad root, 5 to 7 parts of wild chrysanthemum flower, 3 to 4 parts of zedoary and 1 to 3 parts of licorice root. The Yehua medicinal capsule for treating gynecological inflammation uses honeysuckle flower and weeping forsythia capsule as main medicines, has the functions for clearing heat, removing toxin, stimulating blood circulation to remove blood stasis, relieving inflammation and alleviating pain, and mainly treats gynecological phlogosis. The preparation method has the advantages of scientific method, stable technology and high rate of finished products, guarantees medicine quality and is convenient for a patient to take.

source_text: The present invention relates to a technology and equipment for extracting raw materials of traditional Chinese medicine. A condenser (11) and an oil-water separator (13) are connected to an extracting tank (14) through pipelines to form one circulating loop, and a circulation pump (7) is connected through a pipeline to form the other circulation loop. Raw materials of traditional Chinese medicine are contained in a basket (17) and loaded in the extracting tank, and solvent is added. The raw materials are heated by steam for extracting, and medicine liquid is pumped in the extracting tank once again by the circulation pump through the circulation loops for carrying out dynamic circulation extraction. Evaporated essential oil in the raw materials of traditional Chinese medicine is separated through the condenser and the oil-water separator, and the separated solvent is used as new solvent and a heat source, which flows back to the extracting tank through the circulation loops for a next turn of circulation. The previous steps are carried out synchronously for repeated circulation until extraction is finished. The traditional Chinese medicine basket with a gap is arranged in the extracting tank, and the top of the equipment is provided with a top cover which can be opened fully. The present invention has the advantages of high extraction rate, homogeneous extracting liquid, realization of closed and circulated operation of the medicine liquid and full-automatic control, which satisfies the requirement of GMP for medicine production.

target_text: 本发明提供的一种生物层析凝胶及其生产工艺属于生化技术领域。它解决了现有的生物层析用凝胶所存在的价格昂贵、合成再生较复杂等缺点。本生物层析凝胶主要是由分子量在10万至12万之间的聚氨糖所组成，其生产工艺是将一定量的壳聚糖溶于酸性介质中，并进行降解，降解的时间不小于3小时；降解所得的聚氨糖滴于氢氧化钠溶液中，然后水洗至中性；水洗后的聚氨糖移到容器中，搅拌，同时滴加交联剂，充分交联；交联反应后，用还原剂还原；还原后水洗至中性，用60至200目的分样筛分样，得到生物层析凝胶。本发明采用聚氨糖作为生物层析凝胶的主要原料，具有良好的生物相容性、表面基团丰富、pH值使用范围宽等优点。

source_text: The present invention discloses a sol-gel in-situ and self-assembly synthesis method of compound light catalytic materials, and belongs to a preparation method of nanometer functional materials. The method comprises the following steps of completely dissolving metal chlorine salts in a proper quantity of solvents, adding the mixed liquor of phthalic nitrile in a definite proportion, fully stirring the mixed liquor and the solvents for 1 to 2 hours at room temperature, adding a proper quantity of butyl titanate, adding a proper quantity of hydrochloric acid as hydrolyzing inhibiting agents and regulating agents for a pH value, continuously stirring the mixtures at room temperature, and drying and heating formed dried gel to obtain the nanometer compound light catalyst. In the preparation process, metal phthalocyanine complexes and TiO2 are simultaneously formed in situ in a self-assembly mode, and obtained organic matters and inorganic matters have the advantages of clean limiting surfaces, strong associative property and high stability, and are favorable for the transfer of photoproduction electrons and the absorbed energy between the organic matters and the inorganic matters. The prepared compound light catalyst of the inorganic TiO2 base metal phthalocyanine complexes can be extended to a visual light absorption spectrum, and the photocatalytic degradation efficiency is greatly increased.

source_text: The invention relates to a method for blow forming a container (1) from a parison (2) made of plastic. After heating, said container is preformed by a gas injected into the container (1, 2) at a low pressure of 5 bar and by expanding the inner volume of said container. The final shape of the container can then be achieved by igniting an inflammable gas injected into the container, whereby the combustion generates a higher blowing pressure, or by injecting an additional gas with a higher blowing pressure of approximately 40 bar into the container after pre-blowing. The invention aims at improving known blow forming methods in such a way that a barrier layer impervious to gases, aromatic substances or the like is produced on the inner side of the container without having to use big machines. To this end, a precursor gas is added to and mixed with the inflammable gas, the mixture is then ignited and a coating is formed on the inner surface of the container by the combustion. Alternatively, an inflammable precursor gas is injected into the shaped, stress-relieved container that has been formed by means of classical stretch blow forming. Said gas is then ignited and once again the coating is formed on the inner surface of the precursor gas by the combustion.
target_text: 本发明涉及从塑料预制品(2)吹塑成形容器(1)的方法。加热后，向容器(1，2)内通入5巴低压的气体，此时所述容器内部膨胀从而预成形。该容器的最后成形是靠点燃注入容器内的可燃性气体，使燃烧产生较高的吹塑压力，或者向预成形容器内充入更高压(约40巴)的气体而完成。本发明的目的在于改进现有吹塑方法，即在容器的内部生成一层不透气体或芳香味一类物质的阻挡层，无需使用大的机器。为此加入先驱气体并与可燃气混和，然后点燃混合气体，该容器的内表面上因燃烧形成一层涂层。另一种方法是将易燃性前驱气体通入通过常规的拉伸吹塑成形的应力已消除的容器，然后点燃气体，在容器的内表面上因燃烧而再一次形成涂层。

source_text: This invention relates to a pneumatic tire having a built-in non-black colored sealant layer and its preparation. The sealant layer is derived from a sealant precursor layer comprised of a butyl rubber, organoperoxide, particulate, synthetic amorphous silica and plant-derived organic agricultural seed flour, together with a non-black colored colorant. The butyl rubber-based sealant precursor layer is build into the tire to form a tire assembly and the butyl rubber component of the sealant precursor layer is depolymerized during a subsequent curing of the tire at an elevated temperature in a suitable mold to form the tire having the resultant built-in sealant. The particulate plant derived organic agricultural seed flour is a renewable raw material in a sense that it can be replenished in nature and therefore not as a significant depletion of non-renewable natural resource. The agricultural plant seed flour is comprised of at least a portion of a ground plant seed (e.g. whole or partial seed portion including for example its nucleus and/or shell) of an agricultural seed producing plant such as, for example, wheat, rye, rice, barley, oat, mullet, soybean and/or corn. The sealant layer may also contain one or more of a liquid polyisoprene and short organic fibers. Preferably, the amorphous silica is a precipitated silica, namely aggregates of primary silica particles.
target_text: 本发明涉及一种有内装式非黑色密封胶层的充气轮胎及其制备。该密封胶层是从一种包含下列成分的密封胶前体层衍生的：丁基橡胶、有机过氧化物、颗粒物、合成无定形二氧化硅和植物衍生有机农业种子粉、以及非黑着色剂。该丁基橡胶系密封剂前体层嵌入轮胎中而形成一种轮胎组件，且该密封胶前体层的丁基橡胶成分在一种适用模型中在高温下的随后轮胎硫化期间解聚，形成有所得到嵌入密封剂的轮胎。颗粒状植物衍生的有机农业种子粉在如下意义上是一种可再生(renewable)原材料：它是大自然中可以补充的，因而不同于不可再生(non-renewable)自然资源的显著耗损。农业种子粉包含农业种子生产性植物例如小麦、黑麦、稻、大麦、燕麦、粟、大豆和/或玉米的研磨植物种子(如整体或部分的种子部分，包括诸如其核和/或壳)的至少一部分。该密封剂层也可以含有液体聚异戊二烯和短有机纤维中一种或多种。较好，该无定形二氧化硅是一种沉淀二氧化硅，即初级二氧化硅微粒的附聚物。

source_text: Disclosed is a resin-coated metal sheet which includes a resin film resulting from an emulsion composition containing an ethylene/unsaturated carboxylic acid copolymer as a main component. The emulsion composition contains, other than the ethylene/unsaturated carboxylic acid copolymer, an amine having a boiling point of 100 DEG C or less in an amount equal to 0.2 to 0.8 mol per mole of the carboxyl groups contained in the ethylene/unsaturated carboxylic acid copolymer, and a monovalent metal compound in an amount equal to 0.02 to 0.4 mol per mole of the carboxyl groups contained in the ethylene/unsaturated carboxylic acid copolymer, and in addition, a crosslinking agent having two or more functional groups capable of reacting with the carboxylic groups in an amount of 1 to 20 mass% per 100 mass% of the solid content of the emulsion composition, and does not substantially contain an amine having a boiling point of more than 100 DEG C, and ammonia. The resin-coated metal sheet is not only excellent in various characteristics such as coatability, lubricity, formability, grounding property, but also excellent in corrosion resistance after an alkali degreasing step, and also excellent in tape peeling resistance.

source_text: In the discharge apparatus, a stage on which a substrate having target discharge areas is placed moves relative to a discharge head unit. When at least one of a plurality of first discharge nozzles of the discharge head unit reaches one of the target discharge areas, the first nozzle discharges a first droplet of fluid material to the target discharge area. When one of a plurality of second nozzles of the discharge head unit reaches the target discharge area to which the first droplet has been discharged, the second nozzle discharges a second droplet of the fluid material to the target discharge area. A first nozzle row of the first nozzles and a second nozzle row of the second nozzles are separated by a predetermined distance in a direction of the relative movement of the stage and the discharge head unit.

source_text: The present invention provided a method of driving a droplet discharge head which prevents the clogging of a nozzle opening of the droplet discharge head or the like and suppresses the futile use of a liquid, and to provide a droplet discharge apparatus and the like. The droplet discharge head has a cavity 121 for housing a prescribed liquid, and droplets are discharged from the nozzle opening 111 by changing the volume of the cavity by a piezoelectric device. In the normal discharge of the droplets, a normal driving wave form DN is applied to the piezoelectric device. In order to eliminate the clogging of the nozzle opening 111, a forcible discharge driving signal DK for forcibly discharging the half of the removing volume dV of the liquid which can be removed from the cavity 121 by the driving of the piezoelectric device is applied to the piezoelectric device.
target_text: 本发明提供一种液滴喷出头的驱动方法及液滴喷出装置等，液滴喷出头带有容纳给定液体的内腔(121)，压电体元件使内腔(121)的容积发生变化，从喷嘴开口(111)喷出液滴。喷出通常的液滴时，向压电体元件施加通常驱动波形(DN)。消除喷嘴开口(111)的堵塞时，向压电体元件施加强制喷出驱动信号(DK)，从喷嘴开口(111)中强制性地喷出一些液体，该液体是可通过驱动压电体元件，从内腔(121)中排出的液体的排出体积(dV)的一半。由此，可防止液滴喷出头的喷嘴开口堵塞等，并且还可抑制液体的浪费。

source_text: The invention provides a method of manufacturing an inkjet recording cast-coated paper wherein a coating solution containing a pigment and a binder resin is supplied to a base paper, a treatment solution having the function of solidifying the binder resin is supplied to the coating layer while it is still wet in order to solidify the coating layer, and the wet, solidified coating layer is brought into pressure contact with the mirror surface of a heated drum and dried to obtain a cast-coated layer. source_text: A method of and system for manufacturing a microstructure having high form accuracy and a manufacturing system is disclosed. On a rough motion stage having a predetermined positioning accuracy and a large stroke length, a fine motion stage having a small stroke length and a higher positioning accuracy is placed. First, the rough motion stage is moved to a desired position. By use of a mirror placed on a laser length measuring machine and the fine motion stage, the current position of a thin film member on the fine motion stage is precisely measured. This measurement value is feed-backed to a stage control device, and a difference between the current position and a target position is calculated by an error correcting unit. Thus, an error correcting instruction value is generated to move the fine motion stage to the target position. Thus, an error of the rough motion stage is corrected.

source_text: The present invention relates to a dialysis method used for preparing nanometer apatites. The present invention comprises the processing steps that aqueous solution of calcium salt and phosphonium salt is prepared according to the ratio of calcium to phosphorus of an apatite to be prepared, the pH of the aqueous solution of the calcium salt is regulated to 7.0 to 12 by ammonia water, the aqueous solution of the calcium salt is stirred, the oil-bath of the solution of the calcium salt is carried out at the temperature of 60 to 90 DEG C, wherein the concentration of the calcium salt of the aqueous solution of the calcium salt is from 0.01 to 1 mol/L, or the aqueous solution of the calcium salt contains modified cations; the concentration of the phosphonium salt of the aqueous solution of the phosphonium salt is from 0.06 to 0.6 mol/L, or the aqueous solution of the phosphonium salt contains modified anions. The aqueous solution of the phosphonium salt is slowly dropped into the aqueous solution of the calcium salt, and the ammonia water is complemented to maintian the pH of the aqueous solution of the calcium salt; after the aqueous solution of the phosphonium salt is added, the mixed solution is stirred 3 to 5 hours at the constant temperature of 60 to 90 DEG C, a sample is put into a dialysis bag and is dialysed 3 to 5 times by deionized water, and the deionized water is changed after used for dialyzing for 15 to 30 minutes; finally, the sample is dried in a vacuum state for 24 hours, and the nanometer apatite is obtained. The present invention can be used for preparing apatites from 50 to 200 nm; compared with a conventional washing and suction filtration purge process, the purification time is shortened 6 to 11 times, large amount of manpower and water are saved, the preparation efficiency is enhanced, and the present invention is suitable for scale preparation.
target_text: 一种透析法制备纳米磷灰石的方法。其工艺步骤是：先按照所要制备的磷灰石的钙磷比配制浓度为0.01-1摩尔/升钙盐或含有改性阳离子的钙盐水溶液，和浓度为0.06-0.6摩尔/升/磷盐或含有改性阴离子的磷盐水溶液，用氨水调钙盐水溶液至pH7.0-12，保持搅拌和油浴60-90℃；将磷盐水溶液缓慢滴加到钙盐溶液中，补氨水，保持钙盐水溶液pH不变；加完磷盐水溶液后，恒温60-90℃搅拌3-5小时，将样品置于透析袋用去离子水透析3-5次，每次透析15-30分钟后更换水，最后样品真空干燥24小时，即得纳米磷灰石。本发明可以制备出50-200纳米的磷灰石，与常规的水洗抽滤纯化过程相比，缩短纯化时间5-10倍，节省了大量的人力和水，提高了制备效率，便于规模化制备。

source_text: The present invention relates to a zinc containing cracking catalyst, preparation and application in the synthesis of single-walled carbon nanotubes. The catalyst comprises aluminum oxide and iron oxide by a molar ratio of 4: (0.2 to 1.0), and the molar number of zinc chloride accounts for 0.01% to 0.15% of the sum of the molar numbers of the aluminum oxide and the iron oxide. In the preparation method, the zinc chloride and chlorides or nitrates of iron and aluminum are prepared to be an aqueous solution according to the molar ratio of the composition of the catalyst; after stir and mixture, the aqueous solution is dried; after sintering decomposition at 300 to 400 DEG C and pulverization are carried out, the catalyst is obtained by multiple sintering at 500 to 800 DEG C. When the catalyst is used for synthesizing the single-walled carbon nanotubes, hydrogen gas is filled to carry out reduction at 400 to 600 DEG C. After heat insulation is carried out for 15 to 60 minutes at a cracking temperature of 750 to 820 DEG C. The single-walled carbon nanotubes are synthesized by filling paraffin gases of C1 to C3. The present invention has the characteristics that metal zinc is used as an alloy element in the catalyst, the corresponding compound is the zinc chloride, and the zinc chloride has a low melting point and is suitable to make constituents uniform in a melting method. The production technology of the single-walled carbon nanotubes can be stabilized by the catalyst, and the single-walled carbon nanotubes have the advantages of high quality and good diameter uniformity.
target_text: 一种含锌的裂解催化剂及制备和在单壁碳纳米管合成的应用。催化剂成分组成摩尔比为：氧化铝∶氧化铁为4∶0.2-1.0，氯化锌为氧化铝和氧化铁摩尔数和的0.01%-0.15%，其制法是将氯化锌与铁和铝的氯化物或硝酸盐按催化剂组成摩尔比配成水溶液，搅拌混合后，烘干，在300-400℃烧结分解，粉碎后，在500-800℃多次烧结得到催化剂。催化剂用于合成单壁碳纳米管时，通入氢气在400-600℃还原，在750-820℃裂解温度保温15-60分钟后，通C 1 -C 3 烷烃气体，合成单壁碳纳米管。本发明的特点是利用金属锌作为催化剂中的合金元素，其相应化合物是氯化锌，熔点低，适合于采用熔融法均匀成分。用此催化剂可以稳定单壁碳纳米管生产工艺，单壁碳纳米管质量高，直径均匀性好。

source_text: The present invention relates to a preparation method for preparing superfine nanometer magnesia by macromolecule protection, which is characterized in that magnesium nitrate and methenamine are used as raw material, the magnesium nitrate reacts with the methenamine under the protection of an organic reagent PEG, namely polyethyleneglycol and DMF, namely N, N-dimethylformamide, a magnesia predecessor is prepared, the prepared magnesia predecessor is dried by vacuum at constant temperature, the dried magnesia predecessor is calcined at high temperature, and the superfine nanometer magnesia is prepared. target_text: 一种高分子保护制备超细纳米氧化镁的制备方法，以硝酸镁和六次甲基四胺为原料，在有机试剂PEG，即聚乙二醇和DMF，即N，N-二甲基甲酰胺的保护下，硝酸镁与六次甲基四胺反应，制备出氧化镁的前驱物，真空恒温干燥，在高温下煅烧，制得超细纳米氧化镁。所获得的氧化镁团聚程度小，粒子分布均匀，平均粒径小：3.1nm，比表面积大：229.08m 2 /g，属立方晶系，样品产率较高，而且原料便宜，操作方便，设备简单，便于实现工业化生产。

source_text: The present invention provides a clean production and preparation method for basic magnesium carbonate for medicine, which belongs to the technical field of fine chemical industry. The method uses salt waste liquid bittern and byproduct calciner condensate as raw materials, and the volume ratio of bittern and condensate is 3: 4. Firstly, the bittern is filled in a reactor, and is heated to 50 to 80 DGE C, condensate is filled slowly under stirring, and thermal insulation reaction is carried out under reaction temperature for 1 hour; after reaction is finished, aging is carried out for 24 hours, and sulfate ions and chlorine ions are washed by ionized water by filtering; light magnesium carbonate is prepared by drying under 90 DGE C to 130 DGE C. The present invention uses industrial waste and industrial byproducts as raw material and is a clean production technique which has the advantages of high product yield, low cost, no generation of pollutants and simple production technique, and the yield can reach 79 to 88%. The product can also be used as food-level light magnesium carbonate.
target_text: 本发明提供了一种药用碱式碳酸镁的清洁生产制备方法，属于精细化工技术领域。该方法以制盐废液苦卤与纯碱厂的副产品煅烧炉冷凝液为原料，苦卤与冷凝液的体积比为3∶4；首先，在反应器中加入苦卤，并将苦卤加热到50-80℃，在搅拌下慢慢加入冷凝液，然后在反应温度下保温反应1小时；反应完毕后，陈化24小时，过滤，用去离子水洗涤掉硫酸根离子和氯离子；在90℃～130℃下烘干制成碱式碳酸镁。本发明利用工业废物和工业副产品为原料，产品收率高、成本低，无污染物产生，收率达79%～88%，并且生产工艺简单，是清洁生产工艺技术。该产品也可用作食品级碱式碳酸镁。

source_text: The present invention discloses a method for preparing a solid solution of cerium zirconium composite oxides of a nanometer stage by a medium and low temperature solid-solid reaction method, which is a preparation method of a composite oxide solid solution of the nanometer stage based on cerium oxide and zirconium oxide, wherein the composite oxide solid solution comprises the cerium oxide and the zirconium oxide. The cerium carbonate and the zirconium carbonate are used as a raw material by the method of the present invention, and oxalic acid is added in the cerium carbonate and the zirconium in proportion. Then, through ball milling and calcination, the composite oxide solid solution is prepared. The crystallization degree of the composite oxide solid solution is high, crystal forms are regular cubic systems, granularity is 20 to 70 nm and a specific surface area can reach 80 to 100m<2>/g. The present invention has the advantages of no solvent use, no waste liquid discharge, simple technological process, low energy consumption, etc., which belongs to environmental-friendly 'green chemistry'.

source_text: The present invention discloses a method and a device for producing catalyst grade super high purity Sb2O3. The production method of the present invention is characterized in that the compressed air of 0.1 to 0.8MPa is sprayed to the surface of antimony liquid from the top of an antimony oxide furnace, and one of the following two modes is used, wherein one mode comprises that each position of a reaction area of a furnace chamber is heated to more than 1100 DEG C in a mode that partial heat quantity is supplied by the indirect heating of an electrical heating element, and the center temperature of the reaction area is more than 1200 DEG C; the other mode comprises that the fume of the furnace chamber is led in a high-temperature gasifying reaction chamber so that Sb2O3 fume is rapidly heated to 1100 to 1600 DEG C; then, the high-temperature antimony trioxide fume is cooled by a quenching mixing device, and dust is collected by a cloth bag to obtain an Sb2O3 product. The used production device is the improved antimony oxide furnace. Compared with the publicly known plasma production method and the device thereod, the product produced by the present inveniton reduces energy consumption by more than 70%, has furnace yield of 6 to 15 t/d and reduces production cost by more than 30%. The present invention has the advantages of simple and convenient operation, easy control of technological parameters, stable and reliable product quality, etc.
target_text: 本发明公开了一种催化剂级超高纯三氧化二锑的生产方法及其装置，其生产方法是从锑白炉炉顶向锑液表面喷入0.1-0.8MPa的压缩空气，并采用下列二者其一：(1)通过电热元件间接加热补给部分热量的方式，使炉膛反应区域各处温度提高到1100℃以上，反应区域中央温度在1200℃以上；(2)将炉膛烟气导入一个高温气化反应室，使三氧化二锑烟气迅速升温至1100-1600℃；然后将高温三氧化二锑烟气经过骤冷混合装置冷却，布袋收尘得到三氧化二锑产品。所用生产装置为一种改进型锑白炉。同公知的等离子体生产方法及其装置比较，使用本发明生产的产品，能耗降低70%以上，炉产量可达6-15t/d，生产成本可降低30%以上，且具有操作简便，工艺参数易于控制、产品质量稳定可靠等优点。

target_text: 本发明提供了一种纳米α-氢氧化镍及其制备方法，该方法是以二价镍盐为原料，加入掺杂金属盐配制成反应溶液；以氢氧化钾或氢氧化钠配制成沉淀剂溶液；在搅拌、同时用超声波分散的条件下，将沉淀剂溶液加入到反应溶液中，得到氢氧化镍，洗涤后干燥至恒重。本发明制备的纳米α-氢氧化镍具有粒径小、颗粒均匀、比表面积大、热稳定性好、在碱性介质中稳定、放电比容量高、自放电率低、电化学循环性能稳定、合成工艺流程简单易行以及掺杂元素含量易于控制等特点，可用作二次碱性锌镍电池或氢镍电池、铁镍电池正极材料。

source_text: The present invention provides a process for treating sewage and the mixed fluid of sewage and sludge, which comprises the following steps: first, a porous carrier pipe is coated with a layer of nonmetallic mineral particles or colloidal particles in a cross-flow microfiltration mode; then, sewage or the mixed fluid of sewage and sludge is filtered again in a cross-flow mode, the water quality of penetrating fluid can reach the standards of reuse water, and the flux of the penetrating fluid is large and stable. When the flux of the penetrating fluid is greatly decreased with filtration, tap water flows through a membrane pipe at high speed in a cross-flow mode so that the particle layer on the carrier membrane pipe and contaminants on the particle layer can be instantly washed away, and the treatment of sewage or the mixed fluid of sewage and sludge can be carried out again after a particle layer is recoated. The new process of the present invention can be used for the treatment of domestic sewage, landfill leachate, car washing wastewater and all kinds of industrial wastewater.
target_text: 本发明提供了一种污水及污水和污泥混合液处理方法，首先在多孔载体管上通过错流微滤的方式涂覆一层非金属矿产颗粒或胶体颗粒，然后再错流过滤污水或污水和污泥混合液，渗透液水质可以达到回用水标准，渗透液通量较大且较为稳定。当渗透液通量随着过滤的进行出现较大幅度下降时，使自来水高速错流流过膜管，载体膜管上的颗粒层及其上的污染物即刻被冲刷掉，重新涂制颗粒层后即可再进行污水或污水和污泥混合液的处理。本发明的新工艺可用于生活污水、垃圾渗滤液、洗车废水及各种工业废水的处理。

source_text: The present invention relates to an electrochemical processing device and a method for organic wastewater by a three-phase activated carbon fluidized bed. Hydraulic distribution plates ae respectively installed at the upper part and the lower part of a shell body of a processing device; the shell body is orderly divided into a water outlet chamber, an electrochemical reaction chamber and a water inlet chamber from top to bottom; the inner wall of the electrochemical reaction chamber surrounding the shell body is provided with a cathode, and the center is provided with an anode; an aeration head connected with an air inlet pipe is distributed in a ring shape in the water inlet chamber; active carbon is filled between the cathode and the anode; electrolyte is added to the organic wastewater, and a pH value is regulated; the wastewater is pumped into a water outlet at the top of the shell body from the bottom of the shell body to flow out, and gas is led in the air inlet pipe; the wastewater processing is carried out at the normal temperature and under the normal pressure; 0.2 to 2.5 A of direct current is additionally added, the water flow is controlled within the range of 1 to 5 L/min, the rate of gas is controlled within the range of 0 to 50 mL/s, and the active carbon is in the fluidized state. The present invention can improve the degradation rate by the combined action of electrochemical oxidation and active carbon adsorption, and the present invention has the advantages of good processing effect and low cost.
target_text: 本发明的有机废水的三相活性炭流化床电化学处理装置及方法，在处理装置壳体的上、下部分别安装水力分布板，将壳体自上而下依次分成出水室，电化学反应室和进水室，在电化学反应室环绕壳体的内壁装置阴极，中心设置阳极，在进水室中环形分布与进气管相连的曝气头，将活性炭填充于阴阳两极间，在有机废水中加入电解质，并调节pH值，将废水从壳体底部泵入至壳体顶部出水口流出，在进气管通入气体，废水处理在常温常压下进行，外加直流电流0.2～2.5A，水流量控制在1～5L/min，气体速率控制在0～50mL/s，使活性炭处于流化状态。本发明通过电化学氧化和活性炭吸附的联合作用可提高降解速率，处理效果好，成本低。

source_text: The present invention relates to a water-saving acidification alkalization mineralization composite direct-drinking machine which comprises a water inlet three-way valve, a water quality preprocessing preposition filter, a high-pressure water pump, a reverse osmosis unit, a pressure water storage tank, a postposition active carbon unit, a water tap and a waste water port which are connected in turn by a pipeline. target_text: 本发明涉及一种节水酸碱复合纯水矿化直饮水机。包括以管道依次连接的进水三通阀、水质预处理前置过滤器、高压水泵、反渗透单元、压力储水罐、后置活性炭单元、水龙头、废水口，其特征在于它还包括在所述反渗透单元的出纯水管道上连接单向水阀及其后的矿化陶瓷滤芯，且在矿化陶瓷滤芯的后置管路上连接出碱性水的水龙头。又在压力储水罐出水管道上用三通连接一个出酸性水的水龙头。将自来水、地下水等通过水质预处理，再通过反渗透技术去除水中各种重金属、农药等对人体有害的物质，使其达到纯水后再通过含有天然矿物质的陶瓷滤芯将纯水矿化、碱化使水富含对人体有益的各种微量元素，并按需要提供酸性水和碱性水，同时实现了无废水排放。

source_text: The present invention provides a potassium ion-unbalanced water quality improving method which relates to a method for saline water quality. The technical problem needing to be solved is to provide a method for improving potassium ion-unbalanced water quality into water for cultivation. The potassium ion-unbalanced water quality improving method comprises the steps of taking and preserving a water sample, detecting the water quality and adopting a water quality improving agent using potassium as a main component. The potassium ion-unbalanced water quality improving method is characterized in that the water sample is hermetically preserved at the normal temperature lower than 25 DEG C for not more than 48 hours; the unbalanced degree of potassium ions is detected by an atomic absorption spectrometry, the level of the unbalanced degree of the potassium ions is determined according to the percentage of potassium content accounting for total salt content in the water quality, and the water quality improving agent is adopted according to the level of the unbalanced degree of the potassium ions and the total salt content; the consumption (g/m3) of the water quality improving agent =[3.82*(the unbalanced level-1)-(the unbalanced level-4)/2]* the total salt content; the water quality improving agent is uniformly sprinkled in a water body after being dissolved by water, and then an oxygen enriching device is turned on for stirring. The potassium ion-unbalanced water quality improving method is suitable for improving the potassium ion-unbalanced water quality into the water for cultivation.
target_text: 钾离子失衡水质改良方法，涉及盐碱水质的改良方法，需要解决的技术问题是提供一种将钾离子失衡型水质改良成养殖用水的方法，本发明包括水样的采取、保存、水质检测和采用以钾为主要成分的水质改良剂，其特征是将水样在低于25℃常温密闭保存，水样保存时间不超过48小时；用原子吸收光谱法检测钾离子失衡的程度，按水质中钾离子含量占总含盐量的百分比确定钾离子失衡程度的级别，并依据钾离子失衡的级别和总含盐量配用水质改良剂；水质改良剂的用量(克/立方米)＝[3.82×(失衡级别-1)-(失衡级别-4)/2]×总含盐量；水质改良剂用水溶解后均匀泼洒在水体中，开启增氧机搅拌。本发明适用于将钾离子失衡水质改良成养殖用水。

source_text: The present invention discloses a method for treating waste water from m-dinitrobenzene production, which belongs to the treatment field of nitrobenzene waste water. The present invention comprises the following main procedures: standing and filtering waste water from m-dinitrobenzene production after regulating the acidity and passing the waste water through an absorption tower filled with macroporous resin, stopping adsorption after reaching the first leakage point, carrying out desorption and regeneration by using solutions of sodium hydroxide as desorbing agents, passing the absorbed yielding water through the absorption tower filled with the macroporous resin again after regulating the acidity, stopping adsorption after reaching the second leakage point, carrying out desorption and regeneration by using solutions of sodium hydroxide as desorbing agents, passing the absorbed yielding water through the absorption tower filled with the macroporous resin again after regulating the acidity, and carrying out decolorization treatment on the waste water, and then the absorbed yielding water is colorless and transparent liquid. target_text: 本发明公开了一种间二硝基苯生产废水的处理方法，属于硝基苯废水处理领域。本发明主要步骤如下：将间二硝基苯生产废水调酸后静置过滤，通过装填有大孔树脂的吸附塔；当吸附达到第一泄漏点时停止吸附，用氢氧化钠水溶液作为脱附剂，进行脱附再生；将前的吸附出水调酸后再次通过装填有大孔树脂的吸附塔；当吸附达到第二泄漏点时停止吸附，用氢氧化钠水溶液作为脱附剂，进行脱附再生；第二次吸附出水调酸后通过装填有活性炭的吸附塔，对废水进行脱色处理，吸附出水为无色透明液体。通过本发明，间二硝基苯生产废水可以实现达标排放，吸附树脂再生性能良好，可重复使用。本发明在产生环境效益的同时又产生经济效益。

source_text: The present invention relates to a new technology for treating high-concentration and hard-to-degrade organic waste water, which belongs to the field of water pollution control; more specifically, the new technology treats the high-concentration and hard-to-degrade organic waste water by adopting combined technology (BCB combined technology for short) of biological oxidation-catalytic oxidation-biological oxidation. The present invention is characterized in that the high-concentration and hard-to-degrade organic waste water first enters the B1 section of the BCB combined technology, and most of biodegradable organisms in the high-concentration and hard-to-degrade organic waste water are removed through aerobic hydrolysis and biological oxidation; the high-concentration and hard-to-degrade organic waste water enters the C section in which the high-concentration and hard-to-degrade organic waste water is processed in the mode of catalyzed oxidation to improve the biochemistry performance of waste water; finally, the high-concentration and hard-to-degrade organic waste water enters the B2 section in which the high-concentration and hard-to-degrade organic waste water is biologically oxidized again. Compared with the traditional technology for treating the high-concentration and hard-to-degrade organic waste water, the BCB combined technology can greatly reduce the consumption of an oxidation agent and evidently reduce running cost.
target_text: 本发明属于水污染控制领域，涉及一种处理高浓度难降解有机废水的新工艺，即采用“生物氧化(Biological oxidation)-催化氧化(Catalytic oxidation)-生物氧化(Biological oxidation)组合工艺”(简称BCB组合工艺)处理高浓度难降解有机废水。高浓度难降解有机废水首先进入BCB组合工艺的B1段，通过兼氧水解和生物氧化作用除去其中绝大部分可生物降解的有机物，然后进入C段，进行催化氧化处理，改善废水的可生化性，C段出水进入B2段，再次进行生物氧化。与传统的高浓度难降解废水处理工艺相比，BCB组合工艺可以大幅度减少氧化剂的用量，显著地降低运行成本。

source_text: The present invention relates to a device and an optical fiber drawing method for preparing a large scale optical fiber prefabricated rod. source_text: The present invention relates to a method for producing light-burning magnesium oxide by using a tunnel kiln to calcine magnesite. source_text: The present invention discloses a method for synthesizing nanometer CaO-SiO2 microwave dielectric ceramic powder at a low temperature. The method of the present invention comprises the following steps: (1) inorganic brine of calcium is dissolved to form inorganic brine solution of calcium; according to that the molar ratio of silicon to calcium is 1:1, silica sol is added and stirred; (2) a certain amount of citric acid is added to ethylene glycol and is heated to be dissolved; (3) according to certain molar ratio, the two kinds of solution are mixed and are heated for evaporating moisture; when the temperature rises into a temperature of 125 to 135 DEG C, the temperature is preserved for 2 to 4 hours; the temperature continuously rises into a temperature of 180 to 220 DEG C, and the temperature is preserved for 2 to 4 hours to obtain black substances; after ground, the black substances are calcined at a temperature of 700 to 900 DEG C to obtain the nanometer ceramic powder of the present invention. The method of the present invention can synthesize pure wollastonite crystal phases with narrow particle size range and 60 nm of particle diameter at low temperatures, and has simple synthesis technology; after sintered into porcelain, the obtained nanometer powder has the advantages of good microwave dielectric property and great industrial application value, can be used for preparing miniature sheet type multilayer microwave devices, such as 0402, 0201 multilayer microwave ceramic capacitors, etc.
target_text: 本发明公开了一种低温合成纳米CaO-SiO 2 系微波介质陶瓷粉体的方法，包括：(1)将钙盐水溶解形成钙盐水溶液；再按硅与钙为1∶1的摩尔比加入硅溶胶，搅拌；(2)将一定量的柠檬酸加入乙二醇中，加热溶解；(3)以一定的摩尔比混合上述两溶液，加热蒸发水份；升温到125℃～135℃保温2～4小时，继续升温到180℃～220℃保温2～4小时，得到的黑色物质进行研磨后在700℃～900℃煅烧，得到本发明的纳米陶瓷粉体。本发明方法能低温合成粒度分布范围窄、粒径在60nm的纯硅灰石晶相，合成工艺简单。所得的纳米粉体烧结成瓷后具有优良的微波介电性能，可用于制备0402、0201多层微波陶瓷电容器等小型片式多层微波器件，具有极大的工业应用价值。

source_text: The present invention provides compounded microspheres containing hydroxyapatite and a preparation method thereof. The compounded microspheres comprise components of the following proportion: 20 wt% to 50 wt% of sodium alginate, 40 wt% to 70 wt% of hydroxyapatite, 0 to 13 wt% of gelatin and 0 to 13 wt% of arabic gum. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing an organic phase; secondly, pouring the proportionally prepared microsphere component into the organic phase at the stirring speed of 100 to 600 r/min, and stirring for 5 to 10 minutes to obtain uniform microspheres; then adding a calcium chloride solution, and continuing stirring for 90 min at the same speed; finally, dumping organic substances, washing the compounded microspheres with water, and soaking the compounded microspheres in water or a 2.5% calcium chloride solution for preservation. Molecularly imprinting polymers which have a single identity to mould plates are synthesized by using the prepared compounded microspheres of the present invention as the carriers of molecular imprinting, and the compounding of the compounded microspheres with hydroxyapatite considerably improves the mechanical strength of calcium alginate microspheres; the prepared compounded microspheres of the present invention have the prospects of being widely used in cell culture, drug carrier, bone rehabilitation, molecular imprinting and other fields.
target_text: 本发明提供了含有羟基磷灰石的复合微球及其制备方法。复合微球的组分和重量百分含量为：海藻酸钠20%～50%，羟基磷灰石40%～70%，明胶0～13%，阿拉伯胶0～13%；制备方法是：先配制有机相，然后将按比例配好的微球组分在100～600r/min的搅拌速度下倒入有机相，搅拌5～10分钟形成均匀的微球；加入氯化钙溶液，保持此速度继续搅拌90min，然后倒掉有机物，用水洗涤，在水中或2.5%的氯化钙溶液中浸泡保存。我们将本发明所制备的复合微球用作为分子印迹的载体，合成了对模板具有专一识别性的分子印迹聚合物。与羟基磷灰石的复合大大提高了海藻酸钙微球的机械强度，本发明制备的复合微球可望在细胞培养、药物载体、骨骼修复、分子印迹等领域中得到广泛应用。

source_text: The present invention relates to Yt stabilized zirconia aggregate powder with a nanometer structure, and the inner part of which is composed of nanometer crystal particles which are less than 100 nm; the powder has a spherical aggregate structure, the particle size is from 40 to 90 mum, nanometer zirconium dioxide particles in the aggregate powder are in body surface contact, and a nonexposed place is a pure cavity. source_text: The present invention relates to a method for improving the technical performance of a magnesia refractory material, which has the technical scheme that the magnesia refractory material is placed in a vacuum device and is vacuumized to-0.05 to-0.1MPa; after the pressure is maintained for 1 to 15 minutes, chromium containing precursor nanometer collosol is sucked in the vacuum state and is pressurized to 0.1MPa to 0.5MPa, and the pressure is maintained for 1 to 15 minutes; the pressure is released, the magnesia refractory material is taken out, baked and dried for 10 to 72 hours at the temperature from 100 to 200DEG C, wherein the chromium containing precursor nanometer collosol is chromium oxide precursor collosol or magnesia chrome spinel precursor collosol. The uniformly dispersed chromium containing precursor nanometer collosol prepared by the present invention infuses the magnesia refractory material, collosol granules enter air pores of the magnesia refractory material and form chromium oxide or the magnesia chrome spinel in situ, and thereby, the chromium oxide content of the magnesia refractory material is increased, and the pore diameters of the air pores are reduced. The present invention has the advantages of smaller air pore diameter, narrow air pore distribution, low apparent porosity, high corrosion resistance, etc.
target_text: 本发明涉及一种提高镁质耐火材料技术性能的方法。其技术方案是将镁质耐火材料放置于真空装置内，抽真空至-0.05～-0.1MPa，保压1～15分钟后；在该真空状态下抽入含铬前驱体纳米溶胶，加压至0.1～0.5MPa，保压1～15分钟；卸压，取出镁质耐火材料，在100～200℃的条件下烘烤干燥10～72小时。其中，含铬前驱体纳米溶胶或为氧化铬前驱体溶胶、或为镁铬尖晶石前驱体溶胶。本发明制备出分散均匀的含铬前驱体纳米溶胶，将纳米溶胶对镁质耐火材料进行浸渍，溶胶颗粒进入镁质耐火材料气孔并原位形成氧化铬或镁铬尖晶石，从而既增加了镁质耐火材料的氧化铬含量，又降低了气孔孔径。具有气孔孔径小、分布窄、显气孔率低和抗侵蚀性好等优点。

source_text: The present invention relates to fertilizer synergist which is prepared mainly by water absorption resin, trace elements, bentonite, sodium humate, zeolite, palygorskite and glauconite in certain proportion. A preparation method of the present invention mainly comprises the following steps that the water absorption resin and the bentonite are premixed in the predetermined proportion; zeolite powder and the palygorskite are mixed in the predetermined proportion; the sodium humate is added into a mixture of the zeolite and the palygorskite, and then, the mixture is radiated; finally, the mixture of the water absorption resin and the bentonite is mixed with the mixture after radiated at second time. The fertilizer synergist of the present invention has effects on improving soil, enhancing soil moisture, conserving water, saving water and enhancing the quality and the yield of the crops. The present invention enhances the stress resistance of the crops, enhances the pest and disease damage resistant capability and the falling resistant capability of the crops, enhances economic benefits and protects ecological environments simultaneously.

source_text: The present invention discloses a method for intelligently controlling cracking severity of a cracking furnace in ethylene equipment, which comprises a soft measurement model developed by using the neural network in view of cracking severity of different oil products, an on-line real time self correcting system of the cracking severity soft measurement model, and a cracking severity real time inference control technique developed on the basis of the soft measurement model. The present invention can be used for eliminating influences on cracking severity control owing to the problems of time lags, instability, frequent jumps, etc. of the on-line analysis meter; when other working conditions (for example the density of raw oil, the load of the cracking furnace, etc.) are changed, the control system can keep the cracking severity stable, and can ensure the smooth running of the system and the yield of products such as, ethene, etc.

source_text: The present invention provides a system for preparing ethylene glycol by ethylene by using epoxy ethane, which relates to production technology of ethylene glycol. The system comprises an epoxy ethane reaction system, an epoxy ethane hydration reaction system, an ethylene glycol vaporization system and a vacuum dewatering system, wherein an epoxy ethane reactor is a tube array type fixed bed reactor; the pipe diameter of a reaction tube is from 40 to 50MM; the vaporization system comprises a multi-effect evaporator system in series and a heat exchanger with low-pressure steam as a heat source; a tube plate of a reboiler of the vaporization system is a steel plate in a double-face composite structure; a basic material layer is carbon steel; a tube side composite layer is Monel alloy; a shell side composite layer is stainless steel. In the vacuum dewatering system, a preheater is arranged in the front of a dewatering tower and heats material feeding solution, and thereby, the temperature of the material feeding solution reaches or is higher than the bubble point temperature. The present invention has the advantages of less equipment investment and small land occupation, and furthermore, the present invention effectively solves the problems of corrosion protection and coke formation of equipment. The present invention also has good economic effect and is particularly suitable for yield increase and additional extension of ethylene glycol production.

source_text: The present invention relates to a method for preparing 2-alkyl-6-acyl naphthalene by Friedel-Crafts reaction. The present invention has the steps that (1) 2-alkyl naphthalene and organic solvent are arranged in a reactor, the weight ratio of the organic solvent to the 2-alkyl naphthalene is (1.2 to 15): 1, and the 2-alkyl naphthalene is dissolved by stirring; (2) acylate reagent, a catalyst and a complexing agent are arranged in another reactor to uniformly mixed, wherein molar ratio of the complexing agent to the catalyst is (1.0 to 5.0): 1; (3) a mixture obtained from the step (2) is added in 2-alkyl naphthalene solution obtained from the step (1) in batches within 0.2 to 1 hours for stirring reaction for 1 to 15 hours at 12 to 30 DEG C to stop the reaction, a mixture obtained from the reaction is poured in methanol solution or alcohol and ice water solution, a water phase is separated, and thus, a target product is obtained from an obtained oil phase by distilling recovered solvent and distillation under reduced pressure, etc. The present invention has the advantages of high reacting selectivity, low energy consumption, little discharge amount of waste water, etc.
target_text: 本发明涉及一种通过Friedel-Crafts反应制备2-烷基-6-酰基萘的方法。其包括：(1)将2-烷基萘和有机溶剂置于一反应器中，有机溶剂与2-烷基萘的重量比为(1.2～15)∶1，搅拌使2-烷基萘溶解；(2)将包括酰化试剂、催化剂及络合剂置于另一反应器中混合均匀，其中络合剂与催化剂的摩尔比为(1.0～5.0)∶1；(3)将由步骤(2)所得的混合物在0.2～1小时内分批加入由步骤(1)所得的2-烷基萘溶液中，于12～30℃搅拌反应1～15小时停止反应，将反应所得混合物倒入甲醇或乙醇/冰水溶液中，分去水相，所得油相先经蒸馏回收溶剂、再经减压蒸馏获得目标产物等步骤。本发明具有反应选择性高、能耗低及废水排放量少等优点。

source_text: The present invention discloses a method for synthesizing 4, 4'-dinitro diphenyl ether. The synthesis method comprises: adopting p-Nitrochlorobenzene as raw materials, and adding cocatalyst monohydric alcohol or polyatomic alcohol under the action of a proper catalyst so as to synthesize the 4, 4'-dinitro diphenyl ether. A yield of the 4, 4'-dinitro diphenyl ether synthesized by the method of the present invention can reach more than 95%. The 4, 4'-dinitro diphenyl ether is synthesized by a method of adding monohydric alcohol or polyatomic alcohol as a cocatalyst during an experiment, so the whole reaction has higher reaction efficiency on time than that of the existing reaction. Moreover, the present invention overcomes the generation of explosible by-products generated by difficult reaction in the process of the reaction. No corrosive raw materials such as strong alkali, etc., exist in reaction raw materials. The present invention is suitable for the maintenance and the operation of equipment, and provides sufficient guarantee for the industrialization of the process.

source_text: The present invention discloses a method for purifying amide and sulfonylamine compounds synthesized from liquid phases, which is characterized in that the steps of the method are as following: (1), 1 mmol of amine-group compound is stirred and dissolved in 3 to 5 ml of dichloromethane, 2 to 3 mmol of triethylamine or pyridine is added to the mixed solution after 2 to 2.5 mmol of benzoyl chloride or 4-tolylsulfonyl chloride is added, the mixed solution is stirred at room temperature, and a gas phase chromatography is used for tracking the reacting process till the reaction finishes; (2), 1.2 to 2.0 mmol of water-soluble amino nucleophilicity scavenger brominating N-aminoethyl pyridinium salt is added to the mixed solution and stirred at room temperature, 10 to 15 ml of ethyl acetate diluting reaction solution is added, and 10 to 15 ml of salt water is used for washing; the mixed solution is dried and concentrated by anhydrous sodium sulfate after organic phases pass through silica gel poles. The present invention adopts the water soluble compound as a scavenger carrier, and a reactive product can be removed by washing with water to achieve the aim of the purified products. The scavenger has the advantages of easy preparation and purification, low cost and high reactivity and purifying efficiency, and is suitable for large-scale synthesis.
target_text: 本发明公开了一种溶液相组合合成酰胺和磺酰胺类化合物的纯化方法，其特征在于，方法的步骤如下：1)1mmol胺类化合物搅拌下溶解于3～5ml二氯甲烷中，加入2～2.5mmol苯甲酰氯或者4-甲苯磺酰氯后加入2～3mmol三乙胺或者吡啶，混合溶液在室温下搅拌，用气相色谱跟踪反应进程，反应完毕；2)加入1.2～2.0mmol水溶性的氨基亲核性清除剂溴化N-氨乙基吡啶鎓盐，室温搅拌，加入10～15ml乙酸乙酯稀释反应液并用10～15ml盐水洗涤，有机相穿过硅胶柱后，用无水硫酸钠干燥，浓缩即可。本发明采用水溶性离子化合物作为清除剂载体，清除反应的产物可以通过水洗除去，达到纯化产物的目的。这类清除剂容易制备和纯化，成本低，反应活性高，纯化效率高且适于大量合成。

source_text: The present invention discloses a technology for synthesizing high productivity of oxime fungus ester, which relates to the preparation of oxime fungus ester. The technology is carried out according to the following sequences: 1.2'-methylacetophenone is used as a raw material, and potassium permanganate is oxidized to obtain 2-(2'-methyl phenyl)-2-carbonyl acetic acid; 2. the 2-(2'-methyl phenyl)-2-carbonyl acetic acid reacts with methyl alcohol to obtain 2-(2'-methyl phenyl)-2-carbonyl acetic methyl ester; 3. the 2-(2'-methyl phenyl)-2-carbonyl acetic methyl ester reacts with methoxyl group amine to obtain (E)-2-(2'-methyl phenyl)-2-carbonyl acetic acid methyl ester-0-methyl ketone oxime; 4. the (E)-2-(2'-methyl phenyl)-2-carbonyl acetic acid methyl ester-0-methyl ketone oxime is bromized to obtain (E)-2-(2'-bromine methyl phenyl)-2-carbonyl acetic acid methyl ester-0-methyl ketone oxime; 5. inter-trifluoromethyl acetophenone oxime is prepared; 6. products in step 4 and step 5 react to obtain oxime fungus ester. The present invention converts the two isomers (E, Z) of methoxy group oxime into an E-isomer. The total yield of the present invention is 39%, which is six times of the prior art. The present invention has the advantages of low cost, little waste water discharge and mild, simple and convenient operation condition, and the present invention is suitable for industrial production.
target_text: 一种高产率肟菌酯的合成工艺，涉及一种肟菌酯的制备。按以下次序进行：一.以邻甲基苯乙酮为原料用高锰酸钾氧化得2-(2’-甲基苯基)-2-羰基乙酸；二.2-(2’-甲基苯基)-2-羰基乙酸与甲醇作用得2-(2’-甲基苯基)-2-羰基乙酸甲酯；三.2-(2’-甲基苯基)-2-羰基乙酸甲酯与甲氧基胺反应得(E)-2-(2’-甲基苯基)-2-羰基乙酸甲酯-O-甲基酮肟；四.(E)-2-(2’-甲基苯基)-2-羰基乙酸甲酯-O-甲基酮肟经溴化得(E)-2-(2’-溴甲基苯基)-2-羰基乙酸甲酯-O-甲基酮肟；五.间三氟甲基苯乙酮肟的制备；六.将第四步与第五步产物反应得肟菌酯。本发明将甲氧基肟的两种异构体(E，Z)转化为一种E-异构体，总产率39%，是现有技术的6倍，成本低，废水排放少，操作条件温和，简便，适合工业化生产。

source_text: In the following citalopram diol refers to 4- (4- (dimethylamino) -1- (4' -fluorophenyl) -1-hydroxybutyl) -3- (hydroxymethyl) -benzonitrile in free base and/or acid addition salt form. source_text: The invention relates to methods for producing alkyl aryl sulphonates by a) reaction of a C4 olefin mixture on a methathetical catalyst to produce an olefin mixture containing 2 pentene and/or 3 hexene and optionally the separation of 2 pentene and/or 3 hexene, b) dimerisation of the 2 pentene and/or 3 hexene obtained in stage a) on a dimerisation catalyst to obtain a mixture containing C10-12 olefins and the optional separation of said C10-12 olefins, c) reaction of the C10-12 olefin mixtures obtained in stage b) with an aromatic hydrocarbon in the presence of an alkylation catalyst for forming alkyl aromatic compounds, whereby linear olefins can also be added prior to the reaction, d) sulphonation of the alkyl aromatic compound obtained in stage c) and neutralisation of the same to form alkyl aryl sulphonates, whereby linear alkyl benzoles can also be added prior to sulphonation, e) optional mixing of the alkyl aryl sulphonates obtained in stage d) with linear alkyl aryl sulphonates.

source_text: The present invention relates to a method for synthesizing piperazine, which uses N-beta-hydroxyethylethylene diamine as raw material, uses water (or 1, 4-dioxane, tetrahydrofuran and enthanol) as an auxiliary agent, and uses Ni-Cu/gamma-Al2O3-diatomite as a catalytic agent. Piperazine comprises the following ingredients of 1.0 to 25.0% of Ni, 1.0 to 15.0% of Cu, 1.0 to 15.0% of Cr, 1.5 to 13.0% of Mn, 1.0 to 11.0% of Zn, 0 to 10.0% of Fe and a mixture of gamma-Al2O3 and diatomite or one of gamma-Al2O3 and diatomite as the rest. The reaction is carried out in a vapor phase. A continuous process is adopted. Operating conditions comprise that the pressure is from normal pressure to 10.0Mpa, the temperature is from 100 to 350 DEG C, the liquid hourly space velocity of hydroxylamine is from 0.3 to 3.0 h<-1>, the molar ratio of hydrogen amine is equal to 1.0 to 10.0, the dose of a catalytic agent is from 0.25 to 2.5 m<3> hydroxylamine/(hr*m<3> catalytic agent), and the concentration of the hydroxylamine in the mixed liquid of the auxiliary agent and the hydroxylamine is from 20 to 60%. The present invention has the advantages of simple technological process, high conversion rate, good selectivity, few side products, concise separation process, low production cost of products, and stable product quality. The present invention adopts a continuous synthesis technology.
target_text: 本发明涉及一种哌嗪的合成方法，以N-β-羟乙基乙二胺为原料，以水(或1，4-二氧六环、四氢呋喃、乙醇)为助剂，以Ni-Cu/γ-Al 2 O 3 -硅藻土为催化剂；其组成为：Ni为1.0～25.0%，Cu为1.0～15.0%，Cr为1.0～15.0%，Mn为1.5～13.0%，Zn为1.0～11.0%，Fe为0～10.0%，其余为γ-Al 2 O 3 和硅藻土的混合物或两者之一。该反应在汽相进行，采用连续式流程，操作条件为：压力：常压～10.0MPa，温度：100～350℃，羟胺液态空速：0.3～3.0h -1 ，氢胺摩尔比：1.0～10.0，催化剂用量：0.25～2.5m 3 羟胺/(hr·m 3 催化剂)，助剂-羟胺混液中羟胺浓度20～60%。本发明优点是：工艺流程简单，转化率高，选择性好，副产物少，分离流程简明，产品生产成本低，采用连续式合成工艺，产品质量稳定。
